After Max is adopted by his late handler's family, a shocking story begins to unravel.

title.en: You Will Not Have My Hate

overview.en:
Antoine lost his wife in the Bataclan bombing in Paris. In a Facebook post, he explains how he resists hate: he opposes that of terrorists to his love for his 3-year-old son. Bereaved, he seems to be losing ground.

Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.
While pursued by a U.S. rival, a greedy Polish mercenary aids a mine worker and peasant girl as they lead a revolution against the Mexican government.

Memo is a shepherd with a mental deficiency but he lives happily in his small world. In 1983, when Memo is framed with the murder of the martial law commander's daughter, his life is turned upside down. He's sentenced to death and gets locked up in ward seven...
The true story of one boy's journey as a victim of Nazi oppression, and how his love of art and music helped him endure the atrocities of the Holocaust.
The story of Beatrix Potter, the author of the beloved and best-selling children's book, "The Tale of Peter Rabbit", and her struggle for love, happiness and success.

title.de: Mistletoe Ranch - Wo das Herz wohnt

overview.en: Aimée is a budding photographer, following her boss around the world. When she receives a mailbag full of letters informing her that her late mother's famous Christmas Celebration has been cancelled, she makes her way back to Mistletoe Ranch to save the family tradition. Once there, she reconnects with her ex-fiancé and Aimée discovers that the key to her heart was right where she left it.

overview.de: Als Frontmann der polnischen Rockband Lady Pank prägt Jan Borysewicz mit seiner Musik eine gesamte Generation – und erleidet selbst einige Familientragödien.
overview.en: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music — while a string of family tragedies shapes him.
A closer look at the ubiquity of the world's most common plastic chair as a microcosm of globalization, aesthetic judgment and economic inequality.
After losing his job as an engineer at the auto manufacturing plant, a man tries to come to terms with his new identity as a house husband.

title.de: My Christmas Family Tree - Mein Weihnachts-Stammbaum

overview.en: When Vanessa receives the results from her Family Tree DNA test, she discovers a family she didn't know existed and travels to their home for Christmas.[W Network]
After a female activist protesting the death penalty befriends a woman with opposing views, they begin a relationship that tests their beliefs.

overview.de: Marie und Luis lernen sich auf einer Party kennen und verfallen einander sofort. Was als Traum von der großen Liebe beginnt, entspinnt sich immer mehr zum Albtraum. Denn: Luis ist süchtig nach Sex. Und Marie süchtig nach Luis. (ARD Serie)
overview.en: Marie und Luis lernen sich auf einer Party kennen und verfallen einander sofort. Was als Traum von der großen Liebe beginnt, entspinnt sich immer mehr zum Albtraum. Denn: Luis ist süchtig nach Sex. Und Marie süchtig nach Luis. (ARD Serie)
One day in the life of three seamstresses, each of whom is hiding a dark and troubling secret.
A wrench is thrown into a small-time dealer’s plan to go straight when one last drug deal with cash borrowed from a dangerous loan shark goes wrong.

A lavish history of Iran's extraordinary art from 1785 to 1925. While offering an overview of painters and paintings of the period and its continued legacy, it weaves together art history and Persian history.
On the hottest day in 50 years, a serious fire incident happened to a busy commercial tower, a gaggle of fire fighters with an indestructible enthusiasm are going to save lives...
To fulfill his wife’s last wishes, a trucker pulls his estranged son out of military school to compete in an arm wrestling championship in Vegas.
A widower develops a new appreciation for life after moving to the countryside, but his pastoral life is threatened when developers target his valley.
The death of an old woman in a Moldovan village leads to a meditation on life, loss and longing as people gather to say goodbye.
Set in 1990s Algeria, an aspiring young clothing designer pushes back against conservative policies by putting on a fashion show at her university.
Experience the horrors of trench warfare through the eyes of a young Dutch soldier as he volunteers to fight the German army in the First World War.

Set at Pensacola's Naval Air Station, "Pensacola: Wings of Gold" follows Col. Bill Kelly who is the new commander of four young officers selected to form an elite military task force. But complicating the Colonel's task is his relationship with his young daughter and one of his officer's romantic interest in her. The colonel himself must also accept his own interest in an civilian doctor.
A Holocaust survivor receives surgery to repair her disfigured face before searching for her husband who may have betrayed her to the Nazis.

title.de: Pietje Bell 2: De Jacht op de Tsarenkroon
title.en: Peter Bell II: The Hunt for the Czar Crown

overview.en: Rascally Pietje and his Black Hand gang tangle with villain Stark as he and two cronies scheme to steal a priceless royal crown.

For decades, Theo Jansen has toiled on the beaches of the Netherlands in his quest to make his beloved Strandbeests self-sufficient. But what happens when, as the artist pursues his dream to create new life, he starts to feel his own slipping away? As he contemplates whether he is the Strandbeests' master or slave, Theo races against the inevitable passing of time and his eventual death.
Cable guys in Eastern Europe connect a dissonant world with lots of humor and philosophy.

title.de: Police Epidemy - Die Bullen sind los

overview.en: Two bumbling cops receive three ransom notes for one missing woman in a case that turns out to be much more complicated than it seems.

title.de: Princes of the Palace - The Royal British Family
title.en: Princes of the Palace - The Royal British Family

overview.en: Explore the unique personalities and fascinating lives of the princes of the British Royal Family in this chronicle that spans the generations.

When popular Stockholm priest Henrik learns of his father's death from a drowning accident, he travels through the dark, endless forests to reach the desolate village in order to investigate the mysterious death. However, his arrival at the village begins to set dark forces into motion, opening a door to the other side where ghosts from the past begin to cross over into the real world. And the ghosts seem to have one single purpose... Vengeance. Suspenseful, thrilling and darkly creepy, PSALM 21 is a terrifying journey from the very gates of hell.
With rare performances and interviews, this punchy documentary chronicles how punk collapsed into ska, new wave, and the mod scene in the late ‘70s.
A chronicle of the British punk explosion of the late 1970s, featuring early live performances by iconic bands and interviews with those on the scene.
An unapologetic look at mud-racing and the culture surrounding it, as one enthusiast questions his life, and the last mudhole in Orlando is shut down.

title.en: Redemption: The Stan Tookie Williams Story

overview.en: The young, gifted and black generation of the 70's who started the British Reggae movement is captured in this unique documentary. Groove to the smooth sounds and see rare footage
A widowed young aristocrat falls in love with a woman who nursed him in the Great War and tries to marry her against his family’s wishes.
A perennially single dating coach attempts to seduce a prince as she helps him navigate the cut-throat NYC dating scene.
A reality -TV star leaves Hollywood and finds herself in Amish country where she must decide between her newfound reality or returning to fame.
Compelling drama based on the real experinces of journalist Richard Boyle in strife-ridden El Salvador in 1980-81.
Olivia Pope goes from White House fixer to protecting the who’s who of the Washington, D.C. elite when she launches her own crisis management firm.

overview.de: Sieben freiwillige Testkandidaten nehmen an einem Experiment für ein neues Medikament teil. Schon bald findet keiner der Probanden mehr in den Schlaf, doch mit dem Ende des Experiments kehrt schließlich auch die Müdigkeit zurück und erweist sich als tödliche Konsequenz: Sobald jemand einschläft, stirbt er. Der Kampf ums Überleben beginnt...
overview.en: Trapped in a facility after an experimental drug trial horribly goes awry, test subjects must fight off sleep—and each other—to stay alive.

The extinction of the Aral Sea is one of the most disastrous human-caused catastrophes in the world history. Rusty skeletons of ships and deserts of salt fall below the horizon, which once was covered by the marine waves - all these images come to mind when you think of The Aral, the world after the end.
This documentary follows the two co-founders of Take Me Back, a charity that delivers school supplies to children in remote areas of Sri Lanka.
Mason is a matchmaking with a booming success rate and is an expert on relationships. When it comes to love, he knows all, except how to hold onto his husband.
This documentary presents these underwater apex predators not as monsters that kill for sport, but as intelligent and cautious creatures with a bad rap.
Straight after her marriage, Hong Kong officer Mina Kao faces a dangerous case of vietnamese criminal refugees.

An ex-con gets released early from prison only to be forced into an undercover unit of six men and on his first day the other five are all killed. Now he must face the men who he was tasked to spy on.

title.en: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J

overview.de: Seit Michaels Freundin verschwunden ist, steht sein Leben still. Ein geheimnisvolles Rezept in einem alten Tagebuch könnte neue Hoffnung bringen.
overview.en: Since his girlfriend went missing seven years ago Michael Sleep's life has been on hold.  But a mystical recipe in an old journal promises to give the answers he's been longing for.
A tech-savvy nine-year-old ends up in Santa’s workshop on Christmas Eve and decides to help the elves modernize their old-fashioned production line.

title.de: Solar System: The Secrets of the Universe
title.en: Solar System: The Secrets of the Universe

overview.en: Journey to the year 2050 aboard the International Space Station and marvel at the three-dimensional sights and astral bodies that surround us.

When an invading alien race drives humanity to the brink of extinction, the crew of an advanced interstellar ship embarks on a grueling mission to retrieve technology from a distant planet to save Earth.

overview.de: Seit einer schweren Erkrankung in ihrer Jugend ist Maddie taubstumm. Davon hat sie sich aber nie entmutigen lassen und konnte als Roman-Autorin Karriere machen. Nachdem ihr Erstling zum Bestseller avancierte, schreibt sie gerade am Abschluss ihres zweiten Romans. Schon bald hat sie viel größere Probleme, als ein passendes Finale für ihre Geschichte zu finden, als ein maskierter Mann vor ihrem Fenster steht. Dieser beginnt ein perfides Katz- und Maus-Spiel an dessen Ende der Tod von Maddie stehen soll. Doch die alleinstehende Frau ist wesentlich wehrhafter, als der Psychopath erwartet hätte.
overview.en: A deaf and mute writer living in the woods must fight for her life in silence when a terrifying masked killer appears at her window.
Traumatized soldiers find healing for their inner wounds through innovative horse therapy.

overview.de: Die Welt am Abgrund: der diabolische Diktator General Bison (Raul Julia) terrorisiert mit seiner gewalttätigen Streitmacht das Land. Über 60 UN-Mitarbeiter hat er bereits als Geiseln, verlangt 20 Milliarden Dollar Lösegeld, der gefährliche Konflikt steht an der Schwelle eines Weltkrieges. Da tritt der Oberbefehlshaber der Alliierten Truppen, Colonel Guile (Jean-Claude Van Damme) mit seiner Elit..
overview.en: Jean-Claude Van Damme leads this box-office smash, adapted from the videogame, about a commando and his street fighters out to stop an evil general.
A team of scientists must act quickly to prevent the sun from exploding and creating a supernova, which would engulf the earth in an armageddon of flames.
T R Y holds a mirror to reality, reflecting on friendship, maturity, and finding oneself.

Inspired by real events. One man travels to an unfamiliar country with hopes of becoming a professional fighter. Upon his arrival, he runs into a series of unfortunate events which leave him broke with no place to stay. He stumbles upon a rugged Muay Thai boxing camp that allows him to train and fight. Through his fights in and outside of the ring, his talent and skill will get him his biggest fight yet, against the world champion _ a contest that will leave only one man a winner in the ring.

title.de: The Artist and the Wall of Death
title.en: The Artist and the Wall of Death

overview.en: Glaswegian visual artist, Stephen Skrynka, has been fascinated with the 'wall of death' all his life. He dreams of transforming the traditional fairground motorbike attraction into an art form. But after a devastating fallout with his collaborators, Stephen decides to hand-build his own wall. A story of embracing failure and the relentless determination of an artist to realise his dream.
This documentary explores the history of nuclear energy through the eyes of engineers, politicians and advocates on both sides of the debate.

In the small border town of La Joya, Texas, police officers patrol the neighborhood looking for human smugglers. But rather than arresting the immigrants, the officers are gathering intelligence on the smuggling gangs tied to Mexican cartels. Slowly the mutual dependence between police and smuggler reveals a system caught in a never-ending cycle, with the immigrant dangerously caught in between.
As the wealth gap widens in the modern world, seven people striving for a better life discover the odds may be stacked against them.

title.de: The Eagles - Himmel und Hölle Kaliforniens

overview.en: Director Alison Ellwood, along with Producer Alex Gibney, meticulously crafts an intimate patchwork of rare archival material, concert footage, and unseen home movies exploring the evolution and enduring popularity of one of America's truly definitive bands, The Eagles.

Tara is a housewife in suburban London who's raising two young children while married to an overworked, self-absorbed husband. In desperate need of a change, Tara makes the bold decision to leave everything behind and buy a one-way ticket to Paris. Her newfound freedom and journey of self-discovery soon gives way to the realization that walking out on your life isn't so simple.
The fourth film in the Purge series depicts the launch of a program that legalizes violence for a single terrifying night.

overview.de: Dakota Johnson und Casey Affleck kommen als Elternpaar nach einer Krebsdiagnose nicht mehr mit dem Alltag klar - bis ihr Freund (Jason Segel) bei ihnen einzieht. Drama nach wahrer Geschichte.
overview.en: A couple's life is turned upside down by a terminal cancer diagnosis, and they find support in their best friend, who puts his life on hold to help.
In this Covid-era Italian thriller, Roxanne, a cold middle-aged pipe organ restorer, battles to suppress her obsessive attraction to her new young and mute assistant.

title.de: The High Frontier: The Untold Story of Gerard K. O'Neill
title.en: The High Frontier: The Untold Story of Gerard K. O'Neill

overview.en: This documentary tells the story of physicist Gerard K. O’Neill, whose visionary research sparked a grassroots movement to colonize outer space.

Combat is part of life. The talented members of Team KOTOBUKI use their impressive aerial fighting skills to help defend and transport goods across a desolate wasteland. For the right price, they’ll take on any enemy that comes their way!

title.de: The Prosecutor, the Defender, the Father and his Son
title.en: The Prosecutor, the Defender, the Father and his Son

overview.en: Two ambitious lawyers face off in the tense Hague trial of a commander accused of committing war crimes in the Bosnian War. Inspired by true events.

overview.de: Survival-Thriller: Es ist wieder "Säuberung". Eine Nacht lang sind alle Verbrechen erlaubt. Fünf Menschen kämpfen sich durch die mörderischen Horden.
overview.en: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

overview.de: Amerika ist im Ausnahmezustand - und Frank Grillo und Elizabeth Mitchell sind mittendrin: Die Purge-Nacht steht bevor; die Nacht, in der für 12 Stunden alle Verbrechen legal sind.
overview.en: Leo Barnes is now the main bodyguard for Senator Charlie Roan, who plans to end the Purge forever. But in one last night of anarchy, a betrayal forces them out onto the streets, where Ms. Roan is the most coveted target.

title.en: Mark Felt: The Man Who Brought Down the White House

overview.en: Based on a true story of the most famous anonymous man in American history: Mark Felt, the FBI second-in command who was the "Deep Throat" whistleblower in the 1970s Watergate scandal.
When an English lawyer teams up with his friend and an American computer expert, they steal back stolen money from a multinational company.

title.de: The Wanderers - Terror in der Bronx

overview.en: The Wanderers are a teenage gang who are growing up and coming to terms with life in the city.

Hilarious cult sitcom series which takes the mockumentary format to explore the lives of young people in modern rural Britain, focusing on cousins Kerry and Lee 'Kurtan' Mucklowe and their life experiences in their typical Cotswold village.
An Assistant D.A. working on a murder case uncovers a trail of corruption.

title.de: Touch the Sound - A Sound Journey with Evelyn Glennie

overview.en: A nearly deaf percussionist explores the deep connections between sound, rhythm, and body.
A widowed investor rebuilds a vintage race car that gains the power to fly, leading him and his children on an unforgettable adventure.

title.de: Two Moon Junction - Fesseln der Leidenschaft

overview.en: A beautiful southern debutante is about to marry a man just as privileged as she. But when she locks eyes with a rough-hewn, sensual carnival worker, she is drawn into an erotically charged battle of wills that will change her life forever.

FBI meets DEA when two cocky agents (Dylan Sprouse, Mason Gooding) discover they've been working the same case - on opposite sides. Trapped by a sniper and surrounded by bodies, they must unite or die trying.

overview.de: Ein zufälliges Treffen bringt eine Ex-Polizistin in Kontakt mit ihrem ehemaligen Freund, einem New Yorker Polizisten, der sie überredet, ihr außergewöhnliches Gedächtnis zur Aufklärung von Verbrechen einzusetzen.
overview.en: Carrie Wells is a former NY Police detective who has a rare medical condition that gives her the ability to visually remember everything. She rejoins the force and uses her ability to solve crimes.
In the Belgian hamlet of Verbrande Brug, former lovers Monique and Louis reconnect at a carnival, stirring up drama with their current partners.
A teenage girl runs away after a fight with her father, sparking a major police investigation.

overview.de: Eine Stunde noch, dann neigt sich auch diese Nacht in Berlin wieder dem Ende zu. Vor einem Club lernt Victoria (Laia Costa), eine junge Frau aus Madrid, vier Berliner Jungs kennen – Sonne (Frederick Lau), Boxer (Franz Rogowski), Blinker (Burak Yigit) und Fuß (Max Mauff). Der Funke zwischen ihr und Sonne springt sofort über, aber Zeit füreinander haben die beiden nicht. Sonne und seine Kumpels haben noch etwas vor. Um eine Schuld zu begleichen, haben sie sich auf eine krumme Sache eingelassen. Als einer von ihnen unerwartet ausfällt, soll Victoria als Fahrerin einspringen. Was für sie wie ein großes Abenteuer beginnt, entwickelt sich zunächst zu einem verrückten euphorischen Tanz – und dann schnell zum Albtraum. Während der Tag langsam anbricht, geht es für Victoria und Sonne auf einmal um Alles oder Nichts...
overview.en: Berlin, 4am. Victoria, a young woman from Madrid, meets Sonne and his three mates outside a club. The local guys promise to show Victoria the real side of the city, but they owe someone a dangerous favour that requires repaying that evening. As Victoria's flirtation with Sonne deepens into something more he convinces her to come along for the ride. And as the night takes on an ever more menacing c
A wounded outlaw nursed back to health by three impressionable farm boys teaches them his trade and then enlists them in his bank robberies.

For 45 years East Germany was ruled by a strict communist government, on the geographical edge but political heart of the Soviet bloc. In 1987, a British film crew gained unprecedented access to film everyday life inside the GDR - but only the side of life the state let them see. In this doc the crew return to the places and people they visited then, to see how their lives have changed.
In this adaptation of John Steinbeck's classic novel, a migrant worker looks after his dimwitted, gentle-giant friend during the Great Depression.
Nick returns home after his sheriff father’s death in a suspicious car accident and is left with no choice but to take justice into his own hands.
An unemployed Italian bricklayer struggles to get his family through a harsh Colorado winter in 1925 by doing odd jobs for a wealthy local widow.

Though Azzedine is a Paralympic champion at home in Morocco, he is an outcast. Denied a salary or social care - even the right to train in the city stadium - Azzedine and his friend Yousef prepare for the next Paralympic Games in Rio. Returning after a golden performance, Azzedine hopes for a hero's welcome, but instead he must fight for his basic human rights.

overview.de: Er war ein begnadeter Comedian – doch sein wahres Genie lag woanders. Diese starbesetzte Doku beleuchtet Martin Mulls lebenslange, große Leidenschaft für die Kunst.
overview.en: He was a world-class comedian — and that's not even what he did best. Discover Martin Mull's lifelong artistic passion in this star-studded documentary.
Based on the best-selling novel by Karen Kingsbury. When biological parents try to get their child back, a man and his wife must fight to retain custody of their adopted son.

overview.de: Familie Alexander zieht in ein neues Zuhause. Dort stellt Tochter Hannah fest, dass etwas nicht mit rechten Dingen zugeht und macht eine schreckliche Entdeckung.
overview.en: A family moves into a new home, but as strange things begin to happen around them, it becomes clear that something about it isn't right.
A gay party boy faces a twist when his straight, pregnant best friend shows up asking him to pretend to be the father to her child.
When a drug deal goes wrong, utter mayhem links the fate of three gangs, an unscrupulous cop, a greedy monster, and a street-smart stringer.
A police detective's personal life crumbles as he and his colleague investigate a powerful entrepreneur's shady dealings in Antwerp's nightlife.

7-year-old Aya spends a lot of time in the theater where her father, Asen, is an actor. One night at the end of the show, intrigue, betrayal and tension in the company gradually escalate. Asen’s illusions collapse when he finds out that television star Boyan will replace him. Will Asen succeed to rediscover himself with the unreserved support of his wife and the selfless love of his daughter?
A prison psychologist in Kazichene, Bulgaria, uses unconventional methods to bring out the best in the inmates under his care.
Half-sisters Iva and Maya must grow up quickly when their father Andrey falls into a coma and their world turns upside down.
After disappearing for two days, 12-year-old Radostin returns home with two menacing-looking friends and a rebellious new attitude.
In this documentary, discover the historical roots of deep-seated socio-political division in Montenegro and uncover who was profiting from them.
Four strangers' lives intersect over three decades as they confront grief and hope after the 1995 Kobe and 2011 Tohoku quakes and the COVID-19 pandemic.

overview.de: Als eine geheimnisvolle Meereskreatur eine Küstenstadt bedroht, muss ein Fischer kämpfen, um seine Familie und die Lebensweise seiner Gemeinde zu schützen.
overview.en: When a mysterious sea creature starts terrorizing a coastal town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family and his community's vanishing way of life.

title.de: Der letzte Exorzismus - The Next Chapter

overview.de: Als einzige Überlebende des grauenvollen Exorzismus-Rituals ist Nell Sweezer noch immer tief traumatisiert. Die Ereignisse der letzten Monate scheinen komplett aus ihrem Gedächtnis gelöscht und doch weiß sie, dass etwas abgrundtief Böses von ihr Besitz ergriffen hat. Geplagt von schrecklichen Albträumen versucht Nell ein neues Leben zu starten und tatsächlich findet sie bald neue Freunde. Bis die Vergangenheut sie mit ungemeiner Kraft wieder einholt. Das Böse schreibt ein neues Kapitel. In der direkten Fortsetzung des Überraschungs-Hits „Der letzte Exorzismus“ beschwört das Dunkle die Hölle auf Erden. Produziert von Horror-Ikone Eli Roth („Cabin Fever“, „Hostel“)
overview.en: The next installment of the horror series about a young girl possessed.

overview.de: Der Mars im Jahre 2176. Mehr als 640.000 Menschen haben die überbevölkerte Erde verlassen und leben mittlerweile in versprengten Siedlungen auf dem roten Planeten. Dort werden in unzähligen Minen die wertvollen Bodenschätze abgetragen. Doch in Shining Canyon ereignet sich bei einer dieser Operationen ein verheerender Zwischenfall: Eine lange verschwundene Ur-Zivilisation des Mars wird zu neuem ..
overview.en: Natasha Henstridge, Jason Statham, Pam Grier and Ice Cube must battle it out against primitive Martian ghosts who will stop at nothing to annihilate the human invaders who have disturbed their planet.

overview.de: David Finchers THE SOCIAL NETWORK ist die unglaubliche Geschichte über einen neuen Typus von Kulturrevolutionär: ein unsympathisches Genie, das eine Revolution entfacht und das Wesen menschlicher Interaktion für eine Generation, wenn nicht für immer, verändert. Mit emotionaler Brutalität und überraschendem Humor gespickt, erzählt dieser meisterhaft gestaltete Film von der Facebook-Gründung und...
overview.en: This dramatization depicts how Facebook was created, and how the social media site took off overnight, changing the lives of all involved.

overview.de: In der Hoffnung auf Freiheit schleust sich Gyeongseongs beste Diebin in die japanische Kolonialregierung ein, um Geheimnisse zu stehlen. Doch dann verliebt sie sich.
overview.en: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.
A brave knight enters a treacherous realm to save the Chosen One, but his mission risks unleashing a catastrophic force that could destroy humanity.

Gallic heroes Asterix and Obelix take on the might of the Roman Empire. When Julius Caesar finally fears that he may never be able to defeat Asterix and conquer his village, he comes up with a deal; if they can pass twelve of his chosen tasks, the whole of the Roman Empire will be theirs. If not, they must surrender.
Nicolas Cage delivers a dynamic performance as a struggling truck driver whose life spirals out of control after the spirit of his deceased wife comes to life in another’s body.

overview.de: Eine Gruppe von Frauen beschließt, sich mit Fox News-Chef Roger Ailes und der giftigen Atmosphäre, die er dem Netzwerk vorsteht, zu beschäftigen.
overview.en: The true story of three smart, ambitious women who anchored one of America’s top news networks—and risked it all to stand up to the man who made them.

overview.de: Ein bunt gemischtes Ermittlungsteam bekämpft in dieser Serie, die laut der New York Times „die ganze Familie zum Lachen bringt“, inmitten einer chaotischen Dienststelle Verbrechen.
overview.en: Sergeant Jeffords and his loveable and offbeat squad that must get its act together when their precinct gets a new no-nonsense boss.

overview.de: Spin-Off der "Transformers"-Reihe mit Roboter-Liebling Bumblebee.
overview.en: A teen revives Bumblebee the Autobot after finding him in a junkyard in a small beach town in 1987.

Director/writer Nia DaCosta and writer/producers Jordan Peele and Win Rosenfeld return us to the now-gentrified Cabrini Green neighborhood where the legend began. In this terrifying new chapter, dare to say his name...Candyman, Candyman, Candyman…
After their tiny red puppy grows into a 25-foot giant, a young girl and her uncle must protect their lovable new pet from an evil genetics company.

overview.de: Das Ende der Welt wird krank: Im Action-Thriller vom Produzenten von „Zombieland" geraten Teacake (Joe Keery) und Naomi (Georgina Campbell) in die heftigste Nachtschicht ihres Lebens, als ein tödlicher Pilz-Parasit aus einer alten Militärbasis ausbricht und Lebewesen in zombieähnliche Kreaturen verwandelt. Mit einem Anti-Bioterror-Agent (Liam Neeson) kämpfen sie um ihr Leben - und die Menschheit.
overview.en: When a highly contagious, mutating fungus escapes a sealed facility, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever to save humanity from extinction, as the microorganism spreads and destroys everything in its path.
A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

overview.de: Adonis Johnson kannte seinen Vater Apollo Creed nicht, da er vor seiner Geburt starb. Doch das Boxen liegt Adonis im Blut. Er geht nach Philadelphia, um Rocky Balboa, welcher sich vom Boxen zurückgezogen hat, zu bitten, ihn zu trainieren.
overview.en: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his famous father, world heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. Still, there's no denying that boxing is in his blood, so Adonis heads to Philadelphia, the site of Apollo Creed's legendary match with a tough upstart named Rocky Balboa. Once in the City of Brotherly Love, Adonis tracks Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) down and asks him to be his trainer. Despite his insistence that he is out of the fight game for good, Rocky sees in Adonis the strength and determination he had known in Apollo -- the fierce rival who became his closest friend. Agreeing to take him on, Rocky trains the young fighter, even as the former champ is battling an opponent more deadly than any he faced in the ring. With Rocky in his corner, it isn't long before Adonis gets his own shot at the title...but can he develop not only the drive but also the heart of a true fighter, in time to get into the ring?

Join your favorite monkey as he takes on his most regal role yet in Curious George: Royal Monkey. After disrupting a meeting with a stuffy royal family, George accidentally trades places with the king’s snooty monkey, Philippe. While Philippe puzzles Ted with his flawless manners, George travels to the castle where his fun-loving antics raise eyebrows and bring shy Princess Isabel out of her shell. Featuring all-new music from Andy Grammer, this king-sized adventure reminds us all that doing what you love is the key to happiness.

title.de: Das Ding aus einer anderen Welt

overview.en: After retrieving a body from a crashed flying saucer, scientists fend off a bloodthirsty alien organism at a remote research facility in the Arctic.
A little Gruffalo ignores her father's warnings and tiptoes out into the snow in search of the Big Bad Mouse.

overview.de: Ein kraftvoller Film über einen skrupellosen Journalisten und einen gewissenlosen Presseagenten, die alles für den Erfolg tun. Eine faszinierende Geschichte, ein zeitloser Klassiker, der unter die Haut geht und eine erschreckende Botschaft sendet.
overview.en: An influential columnist hires a publicist to end his daughter’s romance with a jazz guitarist, sparking a ruthless battle for control.
A Persian King exiled from his kingdom by an evil trickster allies with a thief to take his powerful throne back and win back his true Princess.
This is the enchanting story of MOUSE, and his search for a nut. A search that is complicated by three hungry animals who think that he may make a nice meal!

overview.de: Nach der Flucht vor einem goldgierigen Piraten jagt ein tollpatschiger Dieb mit einer bunten Freundesgruppe in einem chaotischen Rennen nach einem verborgenen Schatz.
overview.en: After escaping a gold-hunting pirate, a bumbling thief joins forces with a quirky group of friends in a chaotic race to uncover hidden treasure.
Acting legends Kirk Douglas and Anthony Quinn star in this adaptation of Homer’s epic, depicting Ulysses’ perilous trek home following years of war.
A woman (Close) decides to leave her author husband (Pryce) on the eve of his Nobel Prize presentation in order to finally pursue her own writing aspirations.

title.de: Die Pfefferkörner und der Schatz der Tiefsee
title.en: The Peppercorns and the Secret of the Deep Sea

overview.en: This amazing film tells a story of love and survival in frozen Antarctica and follows the mating ritual of emperor penguins. In summer they find a mate, who lays an egg and leaves to feed. The father protects the egg during the harsh winter until it hatches in spring and the mother returns to feed her young.

title.de: Die Tür mit den sieben Schlössern

overview.en: A cynical TV exec looks at the perfect town inside a Christmas globe and is magically transported to it. When she wakes up in a perfect snow-covered town, married to a local woodsman, she discovers it's not all just a fantasy.
Unveils the enduring effects of the testing of 928 nuclear weapons from 1951 to 1992 in Mercury, Nevada—an area belonging to the Western Shoshone.

title.de: Drei Weihnachtsmänner und ein turbulentes Weihnachtsfest
title.en: Three Wiser Men and a Boy

overview.en: The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mom's new boyfriend. Stars Paul Campbell, Tyler Hynes, Andrew Walker, Margaret Colin.

title.de: Earth Angel - Du bist ja ein Engel

overview.en: Teenager and prom queen Angela only wants to party, giving no thought to her future. After falling for her tutor, Wayne, and hoping to turn over a new leaf, Angela asks him to be her date to the prom. Her boyfriend, Duke, forces her to accompany him after he learns of the news, and the couple gets into an accident from which Angela doesn't emerge alive. Angela unexpectedly finds herself stuck in purgatory. When a familiar departed guidance counselor informs Angela that she hasn't done what it takes to enter heaven, she must return to Earth in order to perform the perfect deed that'll earn her her keep.

Young surfer Nick thinks all his dreams have come true when he goes to visit his brother in Colombia. He falls madly in love with a beautiful Colombian girl called Maria, and everything seems perfect until he meets her uncle, one Pablo Escobar.
After causing The Devil to quit, Stewie and Brian take over Hell.
Set in Rome during World War II, a group of four circus freaks with supernatural powers become the target of a 12-fingered Nazi.

overview.de: Der Killer mit der Eishockeymaske ist zurück: Macheten-Mörder Jason Voorhees macht sich in der harten Neuversion des legendären Slasher-Hits über eine Party-Clique her.
overview.en: Young revelers meet grisly ends at the hands of a hockey-masked killer.

overview.de: Louis und Rachel Creed beziehen mit ihren Kindern Gage und Ellie ein neues Haus auf dem Land. Schnell schließt die Familie Freundschaft mit ihrem Nachbarn Jud Crandall , der viel über ihren neuen Heimatort zu erzählen weiß.
overview.en: A couple and their children move near a mysterious burial ground that unleashes an unspeakable evil.

overview.de: In einer schwebenden Stadt im Himmel, in der Reiche Müll wie auch Menschen entsorgen, wird Rudo für einen Mord verurteilt und in die „Hölle" geworfen. In dieser Unterwelt lauern Müllmonster und Gefahren, denen sich Rudo mit seinen neuen Kräften entgegenstellen muss. Er tritt dem Putztrupp bei, um sich durchzuschlagen. Sein oberstes Ziel: Rache an denen, die ihm unrecht taten.
overview.en: Rudo is framed for murder and thrown into the Pit, where mutated garbage beasts dwell.
When a NASA satellite collides with a UFO, two astronauts strive to track down the alien craft and expose the truth behind the government’s cover-up.

title.de: Get Back - Liverpool: Von den Beatles bis heute - eine Musikgeschichte

overview.en: It's a great pop music myth that in Liverpool everything began and ended with the Beatles. It didn't. Get Back documents the real story of the city's music outpourings, from post war years to present day. It's a story of a city where literally thousands of bands and artists, hundreds of clubs, promoters and managers put on the biggest, loudest and longest party in history. The golden era of The Cavern and Merseybeat generated a massive tectonic shift in popular culture and in the 1970s it started again with a new scene and yet another cellar club at its heart - Eric's. Bands such as Deaf School, Echo and the Bunnymen and OMD led the way. Then Frankie Goes to Hollywood, the Farm, the La's, and The Christians. More recently it continued, the city's bands always inventive and always re-inventing, with The Zutons, The Coral, The Wombats and more. The story is unending but Get Back offers music fans a chance to enjoy the narrative and the sounds created so far in the city that rocked the world.

overview.de: Aufregender Look, starke Action: Als Hightech-Cyborg kämpft Scarlett Johansson in der Realverfilmung des 90er-Jahre-Anime-Hits gegen brutale Terroristen.
overview.en: Major (Scarlett Johansson) is the first of her kind: a human mind inside an artificial body. Discovering her creators lied about her past life to control her, Major will stop at nothing to unravel the mystery of her true identity and exact revenge.

Philip Schale has been kidnapped. As the son of her firm’s most important client--one of Sweden’s most important families--Emily must find him if she wants a future at Leijon. If Teddy wants a fresh start, he needs to find Philip. With her resources and his experience, they might just be unstoppable. From Walter Presents, in Swedish with English subtitles.

title.de: Hitlers Panzerzug - Die rollende Festung des Diktators

overview.en: November 2014: The covert investigator Iris P. is exposed in the media. Step by step came out: She investigated almost six years undercover under the camouflage name Iris Schneider in the left scene and the Red Flora in Hamburg...

overview.de: Der MI6 steht vor dem Kollaps. Ein ominöser Verbrecher droht die Identität sämtlicher NATO-Agenten zu enttarnen, die weltweit undercover in diversen Terrornetzwerken operieren.
overview.en: Bond's loyalty to M is tested as her past comes back to haunt her. As MI6 comes under attack, 007 must track down and destroy the threat, no matter how personal the cost.
Jamie Oliver heads to eastern Europe to soak up Georgia's captivating cuisine and culture, from innovative ingredients to traditional techniques, to inspire his cooking back home

title.de: Jamie Foxx: What Had Happened Was...
title.en: Jamie Foxx: What Had Happened Was...

overview.de: Der beliebte Comedian und Sänger Jamie Foxx ist Oscar-, Golden-Globe- und Grammy-Preisträger. Jetzt kehrt er auf die Bühne zurück, um einiges klarzustellen.
overview.en: Oscar- and Golden Globe-winning actor. Grammy-winning singer. Beloved comedian. Jamie Foxx returns to the stage to set the record straight.
Deep in the French Pyrenees, unexplained phenomena suggest that a convergence of ancient occult legacies may have formed a portal to other dimensions.
An astonishing biopic following the life of iconic French singer, Edith Piaf.
The most iconic dog in film history returns! Lassie's detective skills are put to the ultimate test in this thrilling new crime-busting adventure.
A cross-border island romance between Korean spatial designer Yubin and strawberry farmer Karin.

title.en: Michelin Stars: Tales from the Kitchen

overview.en: An in-depth and honest look at the daily world of Michelin chefs and their restaurants.

overview.de: Clever, cool und nervenaufreibend spannend: Brian De Palmas großartiges Filmremake der 70er-Jahre Kultserie mit Tom Cruise als Superagent auf Verräterjagd.
overview.en: An elite intelligence agent investigates a failed Prague mission to retrieve a computer disk.

overview.de: In seinem sechsten Auftritt als Action-Agent bringt Tom Cruise seine Stunt-Skills auf ein neues Level: Nach einer gescheiterten Mission beginnt für Ethan Hunt ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit.
overview.en: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) chooses to save his team over completing a mission, allowing stolen plutonium to fall into the wrong hands. Now, he must partner with a hard-hitting CIA agent (Henry Cavill) in a race against time to stop a nuclear threat.

overview.de: Kein Plan. Keine Wahl. Geheimagent Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) und sein Team arbeiten im Untergrund seit die IMF im Verdacht steht, den Bombenanschlag auf den Kreml zu verantworten. Während die Agenten versuchen, ihren Namen reinzuwaschen, retten sie die Welt außerdem vor einem globalen Atomkrieg – nach allen Regeln der Agenten-Kunst. Nie zuvor war die Mission so real, so gefährlich und so unmöglich.
overview.en: After the IMF are implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, Ethan Hunt and his new team go rogue. In order to clear their organisation's name, they track down a dangerous terrorist named Kurt Hendricks. Hendricks has gained access to Russian nuclear launch codes and is planning a strike on the United States, but will the new team be able to stop the impending disaster?

overview.de: Mit der IMF aufgelöst, verbünden sich Ethan und sein Team mit einer verleugneten britischen Agentin, die ein Mitglied dieser Geheimorganisation sein könnte und tritt an gegen ein Netzwerk hochqualifizierter Spezialagenten, dem Syndikat.
overview.en: With his organization shut down, agent Ethan Hunt and his team race against time to stop a dangerous network of rogue operatives turned traitors. To defeat them, he must join forces with an elusive agent as he faces his most impossible mission yet.

overview.de: Agent Ethan Hunt genießt gerade seinen Urlaub beim Freiklettern, als ihn eine vom Hubschrauber überbrachte Nachricht zur Arbeit zurückruft: Der kriminelle Ex-Kollege Sean Ambrose hat mit seiner Gang ein todbringendes Virus in seinen Besitz gebracht. Nun gilt es, den Verräter schleunigst dingfest zu machen. Deshalb macht sich Ethan die unmöglich scheinende Mission, das Virus zurückzuholen.
overview.en: An IMF agent (Tom Cruise) tries to stop the release of a deadly virus.

overview.de: Ethan Hunt gerät in ein spektakuläres neues Abenteuer von Rom nach Shanghai, als er sich beeilt, eine gefangene Agentin zu befreien und Davian davon abzuhalten, sein nächstes Ziel auszulöschen: Ethans Frau.
overview.en: Agent Ethan Hunt squares off with a ruthless broker of arms and information.

overview.de: Der Naval Crime Investigative Service wird dann gerufen, wenn Verbrechen begangen werden, die gegen den Uniform Code of Military Justice verstoßen und innerhalb der Navy stattfinden. Das Hauptquartier befindet sich in Washington D.C. und steht unter der Leitung von Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs. Er selbst ist ein Veteran aus dem Irak-Krieg und hat mit moderner Technik wenig zu tun. Aus diesem Grund ermittelt er gemeinsam mit einem Elite-Team, bestehend aus dem Ballistik-Experten Tony DiNozzo, dem Technikspezialisten Tim McGee, der Forensikspezialistin Abby Sciuto sowie dem Gerichtsmediziner Ducky Mallard.
overview.en: NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) is more than just an action drama. With liberal doses of humor, it's a show that focuses on the sometimes complex and always amusing dynamics of a team forced to work together in high-stress situations. Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs, a former Marine gunnery sergeant, whose skills as an investigator are unmatched, leads this troupe of colorful personalities. From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, these special agents travel the globe to investigate all crimes with Navy or Marine Corps ties.
Four couples stranded at a remote lakeside cabin on the eve of an apparent alien invasion discover not everything is as it appears to be.

title.de: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
title.en: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger

overview.en: The landmark documentary film charting the triumphant reunion tour, Oasis Live '25.

title.de: Oasis: Second Night Live at Knebworth Park
title.en: Oasis: Second Night Live at Knebworth Park

overview.en: Footage of the summer leg of Oasis' 1996 (What's the Story) Morning Glory? world tour.

In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay summited Mt Everest - the first to do so. That same year, back in Hillary's home land of New Zealand, the jetboat was invented. With this new invention, Hillary, conqueror of the Himalayas' greatest mountain, strove to also become the first to climb the Himalayas' greatest river, the Ganges.

overview.de: Rache ist cool: Die lässigen Gentleman-Gauner George Clooney, Brad Pitt und Matt Damon bündeln wieder ihre kriminellen Energien - und legen sich diesmal mit Casinoschnösel Al Pacino an.
overview.en: Danny Ocean's team plot a Sin City swindle when scheming casino boss Willie Bank uses dirty money to open a new carpet joint.

Every year in Utah, the world's largest competition for speed records on wheels takes place. Thousands of enthusiasts gather for a week under the sun of the captivating Bonneville Salt Flats. The Borri brothers, two octogenarian Italians, attempt to set the new record in the 50cc motorcycle class, thus making their way into history.

overview.de: Der erste Kinofilm zur Kinderserie! Ryder und seine sechs Rettungshunde erreicht ein Notruf: Bürgermeister Besserwisser droht die Abenteuerstadt mit einer Wetter-Maschine ins Chaos zu stürzen.
overview.en: The PAW Patrol is on a roll! When their biggest rival, Humdinger, becomes Mayor of nearby Adventure City and starts wreaking havoc, Ryder and everyone’s favourite heroic pups kick into high gear to face the challenge head on. While one pup must face his past in Adventure City, the team finds help from a new ally, the savvy dachshund Liberty. Together, armed with exciting new gadgets and gear, the PAW Patrol fights to save the citizens of Adventure City! Joining the PAW Patrol in their thrilling first big screen adventure are members from the original series’ cast along with Iain Armitage, Marsai Martin, Yara Shahidi, Kim Kardashian West, Randall Park, Dax Shepard, with Tyler Perry and Jimmy Kimmel and introducing Will Brisbin.

overview.de: Der erste Kinofilm zur Kinderserie! Ryder und seine sechs Rettungshunde erreicht ein Notruf: Bürgermeister Besserwisser droht die Abenteuerstadt mit einer Wetter-Maschine ins Chaos zu stürzen.
overview.en: The PAW Patrol is on a roll! When their biggest rival, Humdinger, becomes Mayor of nearby Adventure City and starts wreaking havoc, Ryder and everyone’s favourite heroic pups kick into high gear to face the challenge head on. While one pup must face his past in Adventure City, the team finds help from a new ally, the savvy dachshund Liberty. Together, armed with exciting new gadgets and gear, the PAW Patrol fights to save the citizens of Adventure City! Joining the PAW Patrol in their thrilling first big screen adventure are members from the original series’ cast along with Iain Armitage, Marsai Martin, Yara Shahidi, Kim Kardashian West, Randall Park, Dax Shepard, with Tyler Perry and Jimmy Kimmel and introducing Will Brisbin.

overview.de: Bei einem Flohmarktbesuch ersteht die kleine Em ein antikes Kästchen. Das Mädchen ist begeistert von ihrem neuen „Schatz“. Ihre Eltern Clyde und Stephanie Brenck schenken der neuen Obsession zunächst keine große Beachtung, bis Em sich zunehmend sonderbar verhält und immer aggressiver wird. Bei seinen Nachforschungen, was es mit dem geheimnisvollen Kästchen auf sich hat, stößt Clyde auf einen alten, jüdischen Volksglauben, nach dem in dem Kästchen ein Dibbuk gefangen sein soll. Ein Totengeist, der von den Seelen der Lebenden zehrt. Es besteht keine Gefahr, so lange der Dibbuk in seiner Kiste gefangen ist. Doch Em hat den Deckel geöffnet und einem Parasiten gleich hat sich der teuflische Insasse bereits tief in seinen unschuldigen Wirtsorganismus gebohrt …
overview.en: When a young girl finds an antique box at a yard sale, she's clueless to the evil she has released—until the malicious spirit takes possession of her.

overview.de: DI Mackenzie Clarke's made a name for herself in London. Now she's back in the last place she wants to be - her hometown of Dolphin Cove. An Aussie twist on Death in Paradise.
overview.en: Detective Inspector Mackenzie Clarke reluctantly returns to her Australian hometown.

title.en: Tales from the Crypt: Demon Knight

overview.en: A Tale From The Crypt, a lively comedy-horror-action treat! The Collector - an angel of darkness - arrives in a small desert town to retrieve the ancient key that keeps mankind safe.

Scrapland is broke and drastic changes are required. As most of the budget is needed for King Leadfoot and his knights and all money in reserve gets spent by the King's shopping-addicted daughter Magnesia, Royal Scribe Inky Earnie has only one option to present: The enormous costs of the knights need to be cut down completely since they are not needed in times of peace.
Keiji is more than just an ordinary rooster - he’s humanity’s greatest defender!
After his bet with an angel has reached its time limit, Santa returns to his evil self, ready to wreak havoc on the world during the holidays.

overview.de: Grusel! Scooby-Doo und die Mitglieder der Mystery AG Fred (Freddie Prinze Jr.), Daphne (Sarah Michelle Gellar), Shaggy (Matthew Lillard) und Velma (Linda Cardellini) werden auf die super-coole Vergnügungsinsel "Spooky Island" gerufen. Der Besitzer Emile Manavarious (Rowan Atkinson) bittet die fünf Freunde, eine Reihe übernatürlicher Zwischenfälle aufzuklären. Sie sollen diesen Fall lösen, noch bevor die mysteriösen Geschehnisse an die Öffentlichkeit gelangen und die Besucher vergraulen. Bei diesem Abenteuer müssen Scooby-Doo und seine Freunde allerdings alles vergessen, was sie bisher über falsche Geister und fiese Dämonen zu wissen meinten. Doch mit kriminalistischen Scharfsinn und viel Mut retten sie am Ende nicht nur sich selbst, sondern vielleicht auch... die Welt! Huuhhhaaa!
overview.en: Mystery mutt Scooby-Doo and his human pals from the beloved cartoon series are brought to dazzling life in this "fast, frenetic and funny" (Variety) live-action feature. The adventure begins as the Mystery Inc. gang -- hunky dope Fred, sexy maiden-in-distress Daphne, brainy, but nerdy Velma, ultra-hip 'fraidy cat Shaggy and, of course, Scooby-Doo -- reunite for a spooky new adventure involving a ghostly series of events at a haunted-house-themed amusement park. Before you can say "Zoinks, Scoob," the meddling mystery mavens have the not-so-supernatural bad guys on the run in this hilarious adventure. With Matthew Lillard, Freddie Prinze Jr., Sarah Michelle Gellar, Linda Cardellini and Rowan Atkinson.

overview.de: Ein maskierter Unbekannter erschafft mit seiner Monstermaschine die klassischen Gegner der Mystery AG neu und lässt sie auf die Stadt Coolsville los.
overview.en: The gang investigates a group of ghouls.

overview.de: Some children have demons in them. Baturay Özdemir talks about relationships, generational differences and the cost of growth in his show.
overview.en: Some children have demons in them. Baturay Özdemir talks about relationships, generational differences and the cost of growth in his show.

Based on the best selling novel, "Simon And The Oaks" explores the toll WWII took on Jews in Europe, forcing them to hide and reinvent themselves to survive - only to later find their true selves again.

overview.de: Nach einem bizarren, traumatischen Vorfall mit einem Patienten hat Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) erschreckende Visionen. Als die Grenzen zwischen Realität und Alpträumen verschwimmen, muss sich Rose ihrer beunruhigenden Vergangenheit stellen.
overview.en: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic incident involving a patient, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing frightening occurrences that she can't explain. As an overwhelming terror begins taking over her life, Rose must confront her troubling past in order to survive and escape her horrifying new reality.

title.de: Soaring Highs and Brutal Lows: The Voices of Women in Metal
title.en: Soaring Highs and Brutal Lows: The Voices of Women in Metal

overview.en: Celebrating the stories of eight female vocalists in the heavy metal genre, through personal interviews, behind-the-scenes insights, and concerts.
True crime influencer Kara Chamberlain investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases. The docuseries shines a light on investigations that have gone cold.

After a ruthless tech giant acquires his company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to program her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.
When a young boy stows away on a spaceship, it is up to a mercenary captain and his crew of cosmic pirates to conquer a robot army and bring him home.

overview.de: Mit einem bahnbrechenden visuellen Stil, der seinesgleichen sucht, vereinen Phil Lord und Chris Miller, die kreativen Köpfe hinter „The Lego Movie“ und „21 Jump Street“, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent zu einer innovativen Version eines einzigartigen Spider-Man Universums. SPIDER-MAN: A NEW UNIVERSE präsentiert die grenzenlosen Möglichkeiten des Spider-Verse.
overview.en: Bitten by a radioactive spider in the subway, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales suddenly develops mysterious powers that transform him into the one and only Spider-Man.

overview.de: Nach Avengers: Endgame muss sich Spider-Man neuen Bedrohungen in einer Welt stellen, die sich für immer verändert hat.
overview.en: Spider-Man's European vacation takes a dangerous turn when Nick Fury recruits him to investigate mysterious attacks across the continent.

overview.de: Von Marvel: Immer noch euphorisch von dem packenden Kampf mit den Avengers, kehrt Peter in seine Heimat zurück, wo er mit seiner Tante May (Marisa Tomei) und unter dem wachsamen Auge seines neuen Mentors Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.) lebt.
overview.en: A young Peter Parker embraces his newfound identity as the web-slinging superhero, Spider-Man, while still trying to navigate life as a teenager.

overview.de: Ein Spion, eine Auftragsmörderin und ein Mädchen mit telepathischen Fähigkeiten geben vor, eine Familie zu sein, ohne von der Identität der jeweils anderen zu wissen.
overview.en: World peace is at stake and secret agent Twilight must undergo his most difficult mission yet--pretend to be a family man. Posing as a loving husband and father, he'll infiltrate an elite school to get close to a high-profile politician.

overview.de: Im Oktober 2017 verschwindet Dr. Ruja Ignatova spurlos. Sie ist damals 37 Jahre alt, 20 Milliarden schwer und immer noch die meistgesuchte Frau der Welt. Bis heute ranken sich wilde Geschichte um die hochbegabte junge Frau, die sich selbst die Cryptoqueen und Bitcoin-Killerin nannte.
overview.en: Im Oktober 2017 verschwindet Dr. Ruja Ignatova spurlos. Sie ist damals 37 Jahre alt, 20 Milliarden schwer und immer noch die meistgesuchte Frau der Welt. Bis heute ranken sich wilde Geschichte um die hochbegabte junge Frau, die sich selbst die Cryptoqueen und Bitcoin-Killerin nannte.

overview.de: Heute führt er ein Leben als High-School-Außenseiter, versteht sich jedoch gut mit seiner Jugendliebe Gwen Stacy (Emma Stone).
overview.en: Peter Parker investigates his parents' disappearance.

title.de: The Amazing Spider-Man 2: Rise of Electro

overview.de: Peter Parker alias Spider-Man kämpft gegen den skrupellosen Bösewicht Electro.
overview.en: A new villain makes Peter Parker realise that all his enemies have one thing in common: Oscorp.

title.de: The Continental - Aus der Welt von John Wick
title.en: The Continental: From the World of John Wick

overview.en: Winston Scott is roped into an underground world of assassins and must make things right after his estranged brother’s attack on the Continental.
“Snowfall” characters Wanda and Leon chase reinvention in ’90s L.A. as West Coast rap rises.

title.de: The Four Warriors - Der finale Kampf

overview.en: Four battle-weary Crusaders take on a mission to track down the evil predator who has abducted all the men & children from a devastated village.

This is the story of how the U.S. quickly built its army and transformed its military technology into effective weapons in what would become a war of machines that allowed Allied victory in World War I. This is also the story of how the stage for a new world order was set, one that would lead to World War II, conflict in the Middle East, and a postwar superpower battle.

Two years after the fourth Great Ninja War, the moon is beginning a collision path towards the Earth. The countdown for the survival of the planet begins. Amongst the havoc, Hinata's younger sister Hanabi is captured by the mysterious enemy, Toneri Ootsutsuki. Naruto must overcome great danger on a mission to save Hanabi and the world along with Hinata, Sai, Shikamaru, and Sakura.
Keem’s internal battle leads us through fragments of memory and temptation as he navigates the depths of The Melodic Blue.
On her 21st birthday, a young woman faces a surprise visit from friends as well as a sinister game orchestrated by a mouse-garbed predator.
In this documentary, learn about Zara and Peter, members of the royal family who inspire, create, and bring about change to the world.
Book lovers will be awed by this documentary about a library that holds over 23,000 rare and obscure books, first editions, and medieval texts.

overview.de: Mystery-Horror mit Dakota Fanning: Künstlerin Mina gerät in einem mysteriösen Wald in einen verglasten Bunker - wo sie mit drei Fremden nachts von unheimlichen Wesen beobachtet wird.
overview.en: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night.

In the post-war years, the proliferation of transnational European co-productions gave rise to a cross-pollination of genres, with the same films sold in different markets as belonging to different movements. Among these, Riccardo Freda's ('I vampiri', 'The Horrible Dr. Hichock') 'Double Face' was marketed in West Germany as an Edgar Wallace 'krimi', while in Italy it was sold as a giallo in the tradition of Mario Bava's Blood and Black Lace, combining elements from both genres for a unique and unforgettable viewing experience. When unfaithful wife of wealthy businessman John Alexander (the legendary Klaus Kinski, giving an atypically restrained performance), Helen (Margaret Lee, 'Circus of Fear') dies in a car crash, it initially looks like a freak accident. However, the plot thickens when evidence arises suggesting that the car was tampered with prior to the crash. And John's entire perception of reality is thrown into doubt when he discovers a recently-shot pornographic movie which appears to feature Helen, suggesting that she is in fact alive and playing an elaborate mind game on him... Psychological, psychedelic, and at times just plain psychotic, Double Face stands as one of the most engaging and enjoyable films in Freda's lengthy and diverse career - a densely-plotted, visually-stunning giallo that evokes much of the same ambience of paranoia and decadence as such classics of the genre as 'One on Top of the Other' and 'A Lizard in a Woman's Skin'.
