overview.de: Koichi ist ein einfacher Student, der den Traum vom Heldsein aufgegeben hat. Nur wenige Auserwählte mit können die Heldenlizenz erwerben, doch mit seiner Spezialität ist er nicht einer von ihnen. Im Schatten der Nacht tut er dennoch Gutes, bis er eines Tages mit der Sängerin Pop☆Step von dem Vigilante Knuckleduster gerettet wird und dieser ihm verkündet, dass er ihn zu einem Helden machen wird!
overview.en: Koichi Haimawari is a dull college student who aspires to be a hero but has given up on his dream. Although 80% of the world's population has superhuman powers called Quirks, few are chosen to become heroes and protect people. Everything changes for Koichi when he and Pop☆Step are saved by the vigilante Knuckleduster and get recruited to become vigilantes themselves!
Mahmoud and his family lose their footing after Mahmoud is one of the “Tahrir square horseriders."

It's set out to be an idyllic weekend. Anna and Stefan, Bernd and Marc - two couples spending a few days in the countryside. The expanding open-cast coal mining operation which will soon be swallowing town, woods and meadows, brings them back to their hometown. The place is almost deserted. Nevertheless, the four protagonists are enjoying their visit to the moribund village...art
A family adventure which tells the tale of a golden retriever puppy on a journey across the Australian outback in search of home.
A teenage courier's day turns surprisingly complicated when he accepts a job transporting seven crates through a Paraguayan street market.
Witness the rise and fall of the woman who became Queen Nefertiti, as her journey unfolds in a tale of power, ambition, and legacy.

title.de: Once Upon a Time at Christmas
title.en: Once Upon a Time at Christmas

overview.en: A teen girl and a cop must solve the pattern behind seemingly random homicides when a serial-killing Santa and Mrs. Claus terrorize their small town.

title.de: Once Upon a Time in London
title.en: Once Upon a Time in London

overview.en: For the first time ever, the violent reign of two of London’s most notorious gangsters, Jack ‘Spot’ Comer and Billy Hill, is grippingly brought to life in ONCE UPON A TIME IN LONDON - charting the epic rise and legendary fall of a criminal empire that lasted for three decades and paved the way for the notorious Kray twins to exert their dominance over the London’s gangland realm.
A kind-hearted but naive man invades his three sisters' lives, as his unique brand of well-meaning chaos slowly unravels their worlds.

After coming home from cruise-ship work to find her mother missing, Luna takes a housesitting gig at the eerie high-rise P77 and secretly brings her sickly brother. The place pampers them, then turns on them as its supernatural owners close in. When Jonas vanishes, Luna fights to untangle the nightmare and save him.
While Bird mother Paula is away, her son Peep gets unexpected help from a paperplane.

SHERINA and SADAM, long lost childhood friends, reunite in Kalimantan for the release of a pair of orangutans. The sweet momentum come up short as the baby orangutan, SAYU, is kidnapped. Sherina and Sadam struggle in recovering harmony as they team up to rescue Sayu, and restoring their friendship. The sequel of legendary Indonesian film, with musical nuance and adventurous actions.

1961. Richard Logan, a safe maker, wakes up with amnesia after being found unconscious. A detective hired by his wife was murdered. A safe his firm installed was robbed. Logan teams up with his wife to uncover the truth behind these events.

overview.de: Jonis Freundin Gracie verschwand mit 14 während einer Séance. 27 Jahre später spielen Kinder ein Spiel, das die Ereignisse nachstellt, bis ein weiteres Mädchen verschwindet.
overview.en: When Joni's best friend Gracie vanished at 14 during a séance, it haunted her. 27 years on, kids play a sinister game reenacting it until another girl goes missing. To uncover the truth, Joni must face her fears about that fateful night.

Get ready for an awesome adventure of a lifetime in Monte Carlo! Selena Gomez (Ramona and Beezus) lights up the screen as Grace, a high-spirited high school grad looking forward to a vacation in Paris with her best friend Emma (Katie Cassidy) and stepsister Meg (Leighton Meester). Just as the girls think their trip is ruined when their hyperactive tour guide leaves them behind.

Based on historical events, the national sensation following the notorious case of the Radium Girls in 1928 ultimately led to significant and lasting impact in the area of workplace health and safety and the study of radioactivity.
At a time when business seems to be corrupting our relationship with sport, the indomitable Eric Cantona shows us footballers who've managed to resist.
Lucrèce, the best assassin in the business, is hired to kill an opera singer. The killer poses as a soprano in order to get to her target, but things do not go as planned.

Winner of the Un Certain Regard jury’s Coup de Coeur at Cannes, this daredevil crime caper is the feature directorial debut from Lola Quivoron. With its unique setting in the world of motorcycle stunt-riders, Rodeo is a suspenseful urban drama that tears through genre expectations at full throttle.

In this tail-wagging comedy-adventure from the Creators of "Air Bud", a big-hearted terrier is taken in by a family with a wrestling arena. They quickly discover Russell has incredible wrestling skills. With help from a hilarious monkey, Russell rockets to the top of the sports world and discovers that the strongest tag team is family.
After a secret agent turns up dead in their trendy establishment, the hip owners of a London nightclub stumble into uncovering a diabolical plot.

overview.de: Auf der Suche nach Beweisen für das Paranormale besuchen die besten Freunde Sam und Colby die gruseligsten Orte der Welt, um die ultimative Frage zu klären: Gibt es Geister?
overview.en: Best friends Sam and Colby visit the world's most haunted places in search of paranormal evidence to answer the ultimate question: Are ghosts real?

title.de: Schneewittchen - Nur eine kann die Schönste sein

overview.en: Fleeing her vengeful, jealous stepmother, a spirited princess finds refuge with a group of gnomes who help her fight back against the wicked queen.

overview.de: In diesem Thriller des legendären Regisseurs Wes Craven (A Nightmare On Elm Street), der dem Horrorgenre neues Leben einhauchte, wird nach einer Reihe mysteriöser Morde eine exzentrische Gruppe von Horrorfilmfans zum Ziel eines maskierten Killers.
overview.en: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell).

overview.de: Sidney Prescott studiert an einem College weit weg und dachte, sie hätte das Grauen hinter sich gelassen... bis ein Nachahmungstäter den zweiten Teil in echt auslebt, in dem niemand sicher oder über jeden Zweifel erhaben ist.
overview.en: A masked killer pursues a student (Neve Campbell) and her friends.

overview.de: Seit sie Windsor College vor dreieinhalb Jahren verlassen hat, wohnt Sidney Prescott nun zurückgezogen im Norden Kaliforniens. In ihrem Zufluchtsort will sie nur noch vergessen. Doch während der Dreharbeiten zu dem Film "Stab 3", der auf den grauenhaften Geschehnissen in der Kleinstadt Woodsboro basiert, schlägt der Serienkiller erneut zu. Schnell stellt sich heraus, dass die Darsteller in derselben Reihenfolge ermordet werden, wie es im Drehbuch zu "Stab 3" geschrieben steht. Für Sidney, der einzigen Überlebenden zweier vorangegangener Mordserien, scheint der Albtraum nie zu enden: Der maskierte Killer hinterlässt Fotos ihrer toten Mutter.
overview.en: A young woman, a reporter and an ex-policeman are drawn to the set of a horror movie.

title.en: Belle and Sebastian: The Adventure Continues

overview.en: September 1945. In the village, everybody is celebrating the end of the war. Sebastian has grown (the boy is now 10 years old). He and Belle are waiting impatiently for Angelina to return. But she never reaches Saint Martin. There is terrible news: Angelina was lost when her plane crashed deep in the Transalpine forest. All the villagers mourn her. All except César.
A long-married couple turns to a therapist for help as they make an attempt to stimulate their love life.

1963. A man returning from Baghdad agrees to deliver a message in London. He's abducted by a gang who killed the original recipient. He escapes but he and his girlfriend are targets as they lure the gang into an MI5 operation in Seaford.

title.de: Sin City 2: A Dame To Kill For
title.en: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For

overview.en: Revenge is a way of life for the hard-boiled citizens of Sin City, who grapple with their inner demons in streets that run red with vice and violence.

Dina, trapped in debt and forced to work for an illegal loan company, seeks solace in 'sleep calls' with Rama, a charismatic stranger from a dating site. But as their addictive connection deepens, a string of unexplained deaths shadows her, turning solace into a deadly obsession.
Tetsuo and Yukio battle intergalactic kaiju. Tetsuo returns to a planet of ice 'SNOWBALL EARTH'.

overview.de: Sunny ist eine Schlagersängerin vom Berliner Prenzlauer Berg, die mit einer Band durch Dörfer und Kleinstädte tingelt. Sie sehnt sich nach Glück und Anerkennung als Persönlichkeit. Der Taxifahrer Harry himmelt sie an, doch seine Lebensmaxime, die „schnelle Mark“, ist nicht die ihre. In den Philosophen Ralph verliebt sie sich, wird aber von ihm betrogen. Während der Tourneen muß sie sich ständig den Nachstellungen des Musikers Norbert erwehren. Nach einer handgreiflichen Auseinandersetzung mit ihm und einem Streit mit dem widerlich-dummen Conférencier Benno Bohne, der sie auf der Bühne beleidigt, fliegt sie aus der Band. Deprimiert durch den Rausschmiß und enttäuscht von Ralph betrinkt sie sich, nimmt Schlaftabletten und landet im Krankenhaus. Ihre Freundin Christine kümmert sich liebevoll um sie. Sie schöpft langsam neuen Lebensmut, und eines Tages bewirbt sie sich wieder - bei einer ganz jungen Band, die in einem Hinterhaus am Prenzlauer Berg probt.
overview.en: Sunny ist eine Schlagersängerin vom Berliner Prenzlauer Berg, die mit einer Band durch Dörfer und Kleinstädte tingelt. Sie sehnt sich nach Glück und Anerkennung als Persönlichkeit.

Rebuilding an ancestral home in the wake of nuclear disaster. Combining live-action and animation, Son of Fukushima tells the heart-rending story of a family profoundly impacted by not one but two nuclear tragedies: Hiroshima and Fukushima. Against the backdrop of the world’s largest radiological clean-up, the film follows the family for five years as they live through the unthinkable: a second nuclear disaster. This is a universal and deeply personal story about the inevitabilities of aging, the sacrifices made for those we love, and the relationship between man and nature.
Mientras trabaja en un caso, una guardaparque reza por el regreso sano y salvo de sus hijos, que han sido secuestrados por su abusivo exmarido.

title.de: Spy Kids 4 - Alle Zeit der Welt
title.en: Spy Kids: All the Time in the World

overview.en: Marissa Cortez Wilson is a retired spy who keeps that identity hidden from her clueless husband and whip-smart twin stepchildren, Rebecca and Cecil. However, when a villain called Timekeeper threatens to conquer the world, Marissa springs back into action as head of the OSS, home of the now-defunct Spy Kids Division. With help from some cool gadgets and two former spy kids, Rebecca and Cecil join

Nora Chahyd, an intelligent, determined inspector has been entrusted with the case of murder: an escort girl has been killed in a Parisian parking lot. Several thousand kilometers away, a plane filled with weapons explodes over the Gulf of Guinea. Inspector Nora believes that the two cases are linked together and that they both involve powerful people with authority.
An American doctor, a British nurse and an illiterate Indian farmer join together to transform a Calcutta ghetto in this uplifting, inspirational movie starring Patrick Swayze and Pauline Collins.
1955. A woman attempts to save her father's failing garage after he is killed during a stock car race, but one of the creditors is determined to take the garage.

In this grim and unforgiving environment, Suky discovers a glimmer of hope, a brutal underground fight club that promises freedom to the strongest. With nothing to lose and revenge fueling his every move, Suky must fight not only for his life but for a chance to reclaim his freedom.

overview.de: Ein Konzernerbe mit einem Kunstherz trifft auf eine Frau, die buchstäblich elektrisierend ist. Sie schließen einen Deal, der sein Herz höherschlagen lässt.
overview.en: Cursed with electric hands that keep her from connecting with anyone, will this romance writer ever find love? Enter: a man with a battery-fueled heart.
Based on the true story of Mary Thompson Fisher, known as Te Ata, who rose to fame as an actress and Native storyteller, bridging cultural divides.
A shy teen dreams of leaving her small town to pursue singing. With help from an unlikely mentor, a local contest puts her to the ultimate test.
A group of teenagers at a beachside resort compete for a chance to hone their talents and pursue their dreams at the Teen Star Academy.

In a not-so-distant future where parenthood is strictly controlled, a couple's mysterious seven-day assessment for the right to have a child unravels into a nightmare, forcing them to question the very foundations of society.
Two brothers must re-examine their belief systems when they get a message to revisit the end-of-days UFO death cult they escaped from 10 years ago.
A widow falls for a guy who bears a striking resemblance to her late husband.

overview.de: In diesem atemberaubenden Thriller muss eine Gruppe in Texas zusammenhalten, um eine scheinbar unaufhaltsame Welle der Gewalt zu überleben, die die Nation erschüttert.
overview.en: A group of Texas ranchers fight back when masked killers decide that the annual Purge does not stop at daybreak and keep attacking people.
1958. A young couple expand their coffee bar to include a record shop and a recording outlet, to help a young singer, and to cash in on the start of the rock and roll era.

overview.de: Das junge Yakuza-Mitglied Kataoka wird nach einem Bandenstreit angewiesen sich zurückzuziehen. Odajima, ein Clanmitglied, wird mit der Bewachung beauftragt. Er fungiert nicht nur als Fahrer und Betreuer, sondern erfüllt auch manchmal Kataokas Wünsche. Doch hinter der ruhigen Fassade verbirgt sich eine brutale Rachemission.
overview.en: Das junge Yakuza-Mitglied Kataoka wird nach einem Bandenstreit angewiesen sich zurückzuziehen. Odajima, ein Clanmitglied, wird mit der Bewachung beauftragt. Er fungiert nicht nur als Fahrer und Betreuer, sondern erfüllt auch manchmal Kataokas Wünsche. Doch hinter der ruhigen Fassade verbirgt sich eine brutale Rachemission.

1934. A father is proud of the fact that he's a self-made man. He's worked hard to earn his money & power. His son is a lazy playboy and the father is far from happy with him and begins to feel the only discipline for him may be 'The Lash'. An early screen role for Sir John Mills.
Meet the men and women who are all called James Bond, including a birdwatcher who unwittingly inspired the name of Ian Fleming’s iconic character.
Una estrella de rodeo algo oxidada tiene que elegir entre cumplir una condena en la cárcel o enseñarle suertes vaqueras a una bola de chicos salvajes.
Decades after his adopted brother went missing before a big performance, a man chases a clue and embarks on a vast journey to find the violin virtuoso.

A heart-pounding thriller filled with intense suspense, raw emotion, and shocking twists. When a magnetic cult leader sparks a standoff with law enforcement, a tormented former soldier must face his darkest fears to return to the compound he once fled, determined to confront the man he once revered and uncover the truth behind his wife's mysterious disappearance.
A bandit and a revolutionary team up to liberate political prisoners, defend their compatriots, and risk their lives on a train filled with dynamite.

title.en: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three

overview.en: A New York City detective has one hour to outwit hijackers aboard a subway who plan to kill one hostage every minute until $5 million ransom is paid.

Three young couples set off into the mountains for a weekend of climbing, drinking and lovemaking. But little do they know that they are stumbling into the terrain of a fearsome predator - a wild man, horrifically burned as a child many years ago in a fire which engulfed his gypsy camp and left only him alive. Now he roams the woods in search of his next human prey.

overview.de: Die Vampirkriegerin Selene und der Werwolfhybrid Michael erfahren die Geschichte des andauernden Krieges zwischen den adligen Todeshändlern und den barbarischen Lykanern.
overview.en: With the exposure of well-kept secrets and the tough resolve of one betrayed Vampire warrior, a centuries-long struggle between vicious predators has reached new heights of fierceness.

John Lawlor is a pit-bull DEA agent married to his job. Joey King is a top “Transporter” in Taipei .The two of them weren’t supposed to fall in love, but fate brought them together… before forces of crime and corruption tore them apart. Now, 15 years later, fate puts Joey and John on a collision course during a weekend in Taipei.

1961. A writer fabricates evidence of the Loch Ness Monster, seeking publication. Rejected by publishers, he and friends travel to Scotland, attempting to convince locals with their staged photographs and fake monster prop. Starring Adam Faith, Sid James and a host of stars.
A passionate music researcher delves into the rich and wondrous history of ancient Greek folk music and the meaning behind the nearly forgotten songs.
Wonder Park tells the story of a magnificent amusement park where the imagination of a wildly creative girl named June comes alive.

Zainab, a recently widowed Muslim woman, endures the suffocating confines of her mother-in-law's home where she must remain until the end of her mandatory mourning period. Burdened with financial woes and a secret pregnancy, an unlikely friendship becomes her lifeline as she confronts her grief and redefines her aspirations in a struggle to move on.

Three unlikely bug buddies, Fly, Spider and Worm, fly, spin, and jump into all kinds of adventures in the big world around them. Imagine hopping a ride on a furry dog or dodging raindrops bigger than your house! Using their unique insect abilities, our tiny heroes find ways to help themselves and others out of sticky situations and record their stories in their bug diaries!
Liza is a 40-year old woman who pretends to be 26 in order to get a job in the highly competitive publishing industry. Now she has to make sure no one discovers her secret.
A tough US marine, having just succeeded in his mission to assassinate a Serbian war criminal, must return to the scene of the crime to rescue his captured partner.

overview.de: Um seine Frau vor einem Dämonenkönig zu retten, begibt sich ein rechtschaffener Kriegerprinz aus seinem langen Exil auf eine legendäre Odyssee über Land und See.
overview.en: Raghav, Ayodhya’s exiled prince, embarks on a quest to rescue his wife Janaki with the help of a monkey army, from the clutches of Lanka’s ten-headed demon king Raavan.

The film is set in the fictional town of Balrampur where Vedvyas Tripathi (Vicky Kaushal) better known as Bhajan Kumar lives with his family headed by his father Pandit Siyaram Tripathi (Kumud Mishra). Bhajan Kumar’s life with his family was going well till a question on his identity arises that throws the city in a flurry of rumour and apprehension. Will he survive or fall prey to this onslaught?

overview.de: Eine junge Reporterin und ihr zaghafter Kameramann werden bei ihrer Jagd nach einer Story in das illegale Sandabbau-Geschäft eines skrupellosen Syndikats hineingezogen.
overview.en: Two investigative journalists uncover a powerful criminal syndicate behind an illegal sand-mining operation in this gripping crime thriller.

The film Shershaah is the story of PVC awardee brave Indian soldier Capt. Vikram Batra, whose indomitable spirit and unflinching courage in chasing the Pakistani soldiers out of Indian territory contributed immensely in India finally winning the Kargil War in 1999.

We all revere Tanaji Malusare for the enormous courage he displayed during the battle of Sinhagad, and his ultimate sacrifice for the great cause of Swarajya. However, this grand battle was only a small part of the achievements of Subhedar Tanaji Malusare, a commander in the service of the great king Shivaji. This is his story.

An undercover cop goes to find and kill a crime lord. However, when he realizes that the crime lord's business intentions are good and he has his own challenges, he needs to decide his next step and help the crime lord change his life.

Vijay, the prodigal son of business tycoon Rajendran agrees to take over the reins of the business, much to the chagrin of his brothers. But can Vijay prove himself to be a worthy varisu and also reunite his now-broken family? This movie is also available as Varisu (Tamil), Vamshajan (Malayalam) and Vaarasdara (Kannada)

Pallavi (Nivetha Thomas) and her two friends Zareena (Anjali) and (Divya Ananya Nagalla) get implicated in  a crime after escaping molestation. Alcoholic lawyer, Satya Dev (Pawan Kalyan) a.k.a Vakeel Saab, takes up their case and fights for justice. The rest is a high voltage courtroom drama with lawyer Nanda (Prakash Raj) and certain eye-openers with regard to freedom and choice of women.

Joseph Chandy (Vivek Oberoi) an IPS officer and Kuriyachan (Prithviraj Sukumaran) a very rich plantation owner in Pala, Kottayam are at loggerheads over some issues that arise between the two of them. They continue to seek revenge on each other at every opportunity they get until one day they decide to fight it out, face to face at the church’s annual festival.
A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Georgekutty be able to protect his family this time?

title.de: しあわせは食べて寝て待て
title.en: Happiness Comes from Eating, Sleeping and Waiting

overview.de: Synanthrope—a quiet burger joint with eight ordinary young employees. That is, until it falls victim to the most inexplicable robbery. Now, what was once unremarkable grows increasingly off-kilter… ©Kazuya Konomoto, "Synanthrope" Film Partners
overview.en: Synanthrope—a quiet burger joint with eight ordinary young employees. That is, until it falls victim to the most inexplicable robbery. Now, what was once unremarkable grows increasingly off-kilter… ©Kazuya Konomoto, "Synanthrope" Film Partners

Led by Nao Matsushita, Fumino Kimura, Aimi Higa, Mary Jun Takahashi, and Koyuki, "SKY Castle" follows the lives of five elite women in the luxurious SKY Castle neighborhood. Underneath this glamorous setting lies a battlefield of vanity, pride, and love-hate. This is about the slugfest of wealthy and stunning wives with ambitions... and dark secrets. (C)SLL/tv asahi. All rights reserved.

title.de: テミスの不確かな法廷

overview.en: Hiroto Ikuta, 29, has no stable job, no partner, no plan for the future-and he couldn't be happier. One day, he inherits a hiraya (one-story house) from an elderly neighbor, and his young cousin Natsumi moves in with him. So unfolds a quiet, ordinary life that seems to attract troubled souls who need a break.©Keigo Shinzo/Shogakukan ©NHK

Is she an angel or a devil? Mitsuko is a total coordinator, polishing and transforming a client's visual and inner self. She will make her clients successful by any means necessary. Her next client is Natsu Imai, a perpetually unlucky single mother. Their goal is to turn Natsu into the next CEO of a large family-run company. Will this be a success story, or a raging suspense drama? ©NIPPON TV

title.de: ミッドナイトタクシー

overview.de: Yuu ends up in "Ark," a cheap Tokyo share house full of strange residents - including the unsettling Kirishima. Can he escape this living hell?
overview.en: Yu impulsively visits his girlfriend in Tokyo and ends up staying at a cheap share house with odd residents. After one vanishes, Yu suspects they may be killing newcomers. Can he escape safely?

title.de: 悪女 (わる) ～働くのがカッコ悪いなんて誰が言った?～

overview.en: Li Xianhong, a charismatic entrepreneur, is entangled in a web of complicated relationships with his business partner, Xiaowen, his assistant, Hanrong, and a young woman, Lilian. Lilian reconnects with her senior Jay, and jealousy brews. When Xianhong’s offhand remarks spark a public backlash, social media erupts, and Xianhong faces the decision that could cost him everything he holds dear.

Badrinath Ki Dulhania is a story of Badrinath Bansal from Jhansi and Vaidehi Trivedi from Kota and what happens when the two of them meet. Even though they both belong to small towns, their mindset about gender roles in society and about life in general are diametrically opposite. This leads to a clash of ideologies, despite both of them recognizing the goodness in each other.

overview.de: Wer im Barbie-Land lebt, ist das perfekte Wesen am perfekten Ort. Außer man durchlebt gerade eine existenzielle Krise … oder man heißt Ken.
overview.en: To live in Barbie Land is to be a perfect being in a perfect place. Unless you have a full‐on existential crisis. Or you're a Ken.

title.de: Churchill, Roosevelt & Stalin – Der Weg nach Jalta
title.en: Churchill, Roosevelt & Stalin: The Road to Yalta
The House with a Clock in Its Walls

overview.en: In the tradition of Amblin classics where fantastical events occur in the most unexpected places, Jack Black and two-time Academy Award® winner* Cate Blanchett star in The House with a Clock in Its Walls. The magical adventure tells the spine-tingling tale of 10-year-old Lewis (Owen Vaccaro), who goes to live with his uncle in a creaky old house with a mysterious tick-tocking heart.

In this exciting adventure for the whole family, three kids land in prehistoric times and are adopted by a nurturing mother T. Rex. However, they have trouble getting home after they lose the power key to their time machine.

Mahi, a newly married woman, brings an antique Jewish box into her home. When Mahi and her husband Sam begin to have paranormal experiences, they soon learn that the box is a dybbuk containing an evil spirit. The couple then seeks the help of a rabbi to unravel its mystery. Will they survive this ordeal before their child is born?
Normally happy couple Sito and Ana have an argument while on the lift, and Sito discovers that they are trapped in a time loop. They must fix their relationship to find a way out.

A boy who has lost all hope and the will to live has a chance to encounter a ghost who gives him a new life. But things get complicated when the ghost realizes that their lives and destinies intervene on a deeper level.

Market Down Hai’, Gaurav Gupta’s one hour is a spot on culmination of years of observation and personal anecdotes on the Baniya Way of Life! Having experienced that since childhood, he draws his humour and relatiblity from his own personal experiences which not only make it engaging but also allow us insights on hacks to survive the word of Business Conquering Baniyas, as he likes to call it.

After precocious tween Karin finds herself abandoned by her father in rural Japan, she meets Anzu, a giant and notoriously lazy "ghost cat" tasked with looking after her. Wary of her new guardian, Karin sabotages Anzu's odd jobs for the townsfolk and befriends the eccentric local spirits. But in an effort to win Karin over, Anzu accidentally makes a deal with the devil -- and all Hell breaks loose.

title.de: Hex Hollow: Witchcraft and Murder in Pennsylvania
title.en: Hex Hollow: Witchcraft and Murder in Pennsylvania

overview.en: True crime documentary about the brutal 1928 murder of a Pennsylvania farmer in Hex Hollow who was falsely accused of cursing a man with witchcraft.

A father and his two daughters are sailing in a lake when they encounter a pair of shipwrecked men. They say to be looking for someone they lost and ask for help to find him. This begins a tense search in which the father suspects he is held hostage.
Trapped in a national park, a tiger expert and a group of hunters turn to an enigmatic local for help when they mysteriously begin to die one by one.

Kantara is a story set in the fictional village of Dakshina Kannada which explores the ideological conflict of human and nature. A battle of ego swirls along tradition and culture of the land. Will Shiva, the protagonist of the film be able to reinstate peace and harmony in the village perceiving his existence?
Latin Flow is the story of 9 Colombian women. They are singers, who driven by urban music and female empowerment, seek to open their own space in a very competitive world.

title.de: Loch Ness: They Created a Monster
title.en: Loch Ness: They Created a Monster

overview.en: In the misty Highlands, the story of the infamous fascination with the Loch Ness Monster unfolds through vivid archive footage, rare photographs and tender interviews. Director John MacLaverty captures the dreamers, eccentrics and believers drawn to the hunt, revealing a story less about a creature in the depths, and more about the human need to believe in what lies hidden beneath the surface.
Couples today come from different backgrounds and have independent lifestyles. But their independence leads to friction between them, what will keep them together?

Arjun and Anu are childhood friends. Anu proposes out of convenience but their marriage turns out to be a nightmare since he is not really in love with her. While applying for a divorce, an unexpected twist gives Arjun a second chance. Will they live happily or will they get divorced?
A riotous, multiple award-winning horror comedy. Two high school cafeteria workers face the threat of losing their chance to meet the object of their obsession: Johnny Depp.

title.en: In the Name of Gerry Conlon

overview.en: In 1974, Gerry Conlon was a victim of one of the worst judicial crimes in UK history. Aged 20, he and three others were sentenced to life in prison for an IRA bombing. The "Guildford Four" had to wait until 1989 to be exonerated. Conlon became a world-famous human rights activist. Director Lorenzo Moscia met Gerry two months before his death, recording this testament to a remarkable life.
The film is said to be based on the emotional bonding between a boy and a dog and their love and affection for each other.

title.de: Original Pride: The Satyrs Motorcycle Club
title.en: Original Pride: The Satyrs Motorcycle Club

overview.de: Goldene Palme, Golden Globe und vier Oscars, darunter als "Bester Film", und schon jetzt ein absoluter Kult-Klassiker: Regissuer Bong Joon ho liefert einen aufregenden Mix aus rabenschwarzer Tragikomödie und herrlich pervser Thrillerfarce über eine Familie aus armen Verhältnissen, die in einem vornehmen Haushalt anheuert und sich dort einnistet. Klassenkampf, wie man ihn noch nicht gesehen hat. Nun erstmalig in einer edlen und stylsichen Black&White-Version.
overview.en: A huge international sensation, Bong Joon Ho’s social thriller won the Palme d’Or as well as four Academy Awards®, including Best Picture! As an unemployed family cleverly integrates itself into an unsuspecting wealthy household, this darkly comic film serves up surprise after nail-biting surprise.

overview.de: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…
overview.en: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…
An evil millionaire believes he is Santa Claus after an accident renders him amnesiac. Starring Hulk Hogan.

Village lad Shiva falls in love with the uninhibited and bold Indhu, and so begins a passionate love affair between them. However, this dream is short-lived as she goes on to marry someone else,leaving Shiva a changed man.

overview.de: Blutige Morde, pechschwarzer Humor: Theo James und Elijah Wood kämpfen in diesem Horror-Spaß nach Stephen King gegen einen mordlustigen Spielzeugaffen. Vom "Longlegs"-Regisseur.
overview.en: When twin brothers Hal and Bill discover their father’s old monkey toy in the attic, a series of gruesome deaths starts occurring all around them. The brothers decide to throw the monkey away and move on with their lives, growing apart over the years. But when the mysterious deaths begin again, the brothers must reunite to find a way to destroy the monkey for good.
Three friends decide to play The Red Book game. What they don't know is that evil is in the house, waiting to be released.

title.en: How to Be a Modern Man

overview.de: Andrés ist ein überaus geradliniger Beamter im Finanzministerium. Er sieht sich selbst als rechtschaffenden Bürger und ist überzeugt davon, dass alles einer unumstößlichen natürlichen Ordnung unterliegt. Nach einem Streit mit einer Kollegin, wird er jedoch ins Ministerium für Gleichstellungsangelegenheiten versetzt. Dort sieht er sich mit einer ihm völlig fremden, modernen Welt konfrontiert.
overview.en: A strict, order-obsessed tax official has an unfortunate confrontation with a co-worker and is transferred to the Ministry of Equality.

title.de: Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani - Lass dein Glück nicht ziehen

overview.en: On a trekking trip, an introvert falls for a charming ex-classmate, whose thirst for adventure drives them apart. Years later, their paths cross again.
A writer with a broken heart and writer's block travels to a remote hill station where he rediscovers love and has to take on a copycat serial killer who has risen from the dead.

Chhorii is the story of a modern, young couple, Sakshi (Nushrratt Bharuccha) and Hemant. Sakshi is eight months pregnant with her first child when the couple, forced out of their home, escapes from the city and seeks refuge in a house located deep inside sugarcane fields. The house is inhabited by an old couple who seem to know more than they tell.

An inspiring story about an orphan boy from the streets of Dongri, who grows up to become a local goon of his area and how his life changes after he meets the young and compassionate Ananya, who guides him towards the right path and makes him realize his true calling i.e boxing. Toofaan is set in Mumbai, It is a true cosmopolitan city and a melting pot for various cultures and religion.

When a mysterious murder takes place at exiled billionaire Ashish Kapoor’s birthday party, the prime suspects are his close family and friends. ​As twists follow turns and devious motives are revealed, CBI officer Mira Rao must use all her skill to unravel a mystery where nothing is what it seems and everyone hides a secret or two.

Two crazy, jobless, horror-film addicts Major and Gullu, under immense family pressure to find work, hit upon the idea to float a unique ghost-capturing service when they meet a e spirit, Ragini, who makes their business a success but in return asks them for a favour which they are compelled to honour.
Two estranged, street-fighting brothers square off against each other in a mixed martial arts tournament.
A pilot's flight takes a stirring and mysterious trajectory after taking off from an international destination.

This is the story of two sisters Roop Kaur & Basant Kaur who are born in Zimidaar's family. After Bhagel Singh listens to both sisters singing, he seeks permission from their father to get them to sing for his company. He agrees on the condition that their identity should remain hidden.
Two men in the Pudukottai district experience difficulties when they realise they have different interpretations of the law.

Inspired by the book ‘Simply Fly’, the film tells the story of Nedumaaran Rajangam known to friends as Maara, the son of a teacher, who sets out to make the common man fly and takes on the most capital intensive industry in the world with the help of his friends, family and sheer will power.
An alcoholic professor is sent to teach at a juvenile school, where he clashes with a gangster who is using the school's children for criminal activities.

A 15-year-old boy living in Veeranor, gets struck by lightning and goes into a short coma. After recovery, he gradually realizes that he has superpowers of lightning and mind control. With the help of his powers and demi God "VEERAN" how he handled the villain and avoid the major electirc blast.
CI Shiva Kumar (Allari Naresh) is a brash police officer and it often causes problems both at work and home. What happens when the consequences of his actions catch up to him?
A man seeks to settle the score with a powerful businessman who causes him significant financial loss.
Love blooms between a doctor with an uncertain future and a renowned palmist who thought he would never find love. His beliefs are challenged.

A newly appointed police officer is assigned to a hit and run case, where a pregnant couple lost their child. What seems like a simple open and shut case, turns out to be a complicated web involving several seemingly unconnected people. To solve the case, the officer has to hunt down a serial killer, a trained naxal, a suspended cop, and a terrorist organization, while facing his own painful past.
After being disrespected by both his son and his wife, a man tries to earn their respect by working as a wedding planner.
A couple on the verge of divorce have to stay together during lockdown as a nasty surprise awaits them.
A priest and a police officer are trying to solve a set of mysterious suicides. As their investigation closes in, they discover another crime with even farther-reaching consequences

A young, free-spirited writer arrives to stay in a desolate mansion, rumoured to be haunted by the apparition of a young woman who committed suicide when she was betrayed in love. Based on Vaikom Muhammed Basheer's timeless classic, this reimagination weaves a spellbinding narrative, blending traditional storytelling with modern filmmaking.
A detective from the '90s is connected with a modern day profiler through an old walkie-talkie, giving them a stronger shot at solving cold cases.

title.de: リラの花咲くけものみち
title.en: In Lilac Bloom, The Path to a Veterinarian

overview.en: Un fantasma se niega a dejar la casa que Anna, agente inmobiliaria, acaba de listar. Cree que no puede irse hasta reunir a Anna con su ex.
In Egypt, Cleopatra has made a bet with Caesar that her new summer home will be built within just a few weeks. To win the bet, she enlists the help of Asterix, Obelix and their Magic Potion...
Welcome to the world of Beyblade; this is the story of a group of passionate Bladers who follow their dreams on an unforgettable journey to the top.

Olivia Pierce (Cahill) is a marketing executive from Oakland, California who is this close to realizing her dream of purchasing a condo, but she's a bit short on the down payment. When she learns that her late great aunt left her half of a cat café in upstate New York she thinks it's the Christmas miracle she needed - as long as she can sell and close the deal before the holidays.
A series of murders exposes the secrets of a New Jersey town after a vintage Chucky doll turns up at a suburban yard sale.

title.de: Club der roten Bänder - Die neue Generation
title.en: Club der roten Bänder - Die neue Generation

title.de: Coming Home for Christmas - Der Geist der Liebe

overview.en: While preparing the place for sale, Lizzie plans one final Christmas Eve gala for the family, although they seem to be a family in name only.

overview.de: Bevor Amityville gab es Harrisville. The Conjuring handelt von der grausamen wahren Geschichte von Ed und Lorraine Warren, zwei angesehenen Forschern für paranormale Ereignisse, die einer Familie helfen sollen, die von einer dunklen Präsenz auf ihremabgelegenen Bauernhof terrorisiert werden. Der mächtige Dämon, mit dem die Warrens konfrontiert werden, macht die Angelegenheit zum schrecklichsten Fall ihres Lebens. Vera Farmiga und Patrick Wilson spielen die Forscher und Ron Livingston sowie Lili Taylor spielen die Perron-Familie, die von düsteren Geistern geplagt werden.
overview.en: Paranormal investigators (Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson) confront a powerful demonic entity.

overview.de: Die Serie folgt den frühen Abenteuern des jungen Symbologen Robert Langdon aus Harvard, der eine Reihe tödlicher Rätsel lösen muss, um seinen entführten Mentor zu retten und eine globale Verschwörung zu vereiteln.
overview.en: A young Harvard symbologist must solve a series of deadly puzzles to save his kidnapped mentor and thwart a chilling global conspiracy.

overview.de: Knallbuntes Effektespektakel mit grandiosen Bildern und schrägem Humor: Bruce Willis muss gemeinsam mit Milla Jovovich die Welt retten. Von Luc Besson ("Leon - Der Profi").
overview.en: A prophesized evil that comes every 500 years races toward 2263 New York in the form of a fireball that a cabbie, a humanoid, and a monk must stop.

title.de: Das Märchen vom Frosch und der goldenen Kugel
title.en: Das Märchen vom Frosch und der goldenen Kugel

title.de: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Mugen Train
title.en: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train

overview.de: Tanjiro und seine Gefährten haben ihre Ausbildung im Schmetterlingsanwesen abgeschlossen und kommen am Ort ihrer nächsten Mission an. Im "Mugen-Zug" sind über 40 Menschen innerhalb kürzester Zeit verschwunden. Ein Dämon ist verantwortlich.
overview.en: Falling forever into an endless dream... Tanjiro and the group have completed their rehabilitation training at the Butterfly Mansion, and they arrive to their next mission on the Mugen Train, where over 40 people have disappeared in a very short period of time. Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Ha...

Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.
When a gruesomely staged body is found at the German-Austrian border, two detectives investigate and enter a sinister world of Pagan-like rituals.

overview.de: Auch in seinem Kinodebüt erlebt der exzentrische Meeresbewohner SpongeBob haufenweise haarsträubende Tiefseeabenteuer. Es heißt also abtauchen und ablachen mit seinem Freund Patrick und dem Rest von Bikini Bottom.
overview.en: SpongeBob and Patrick have six days to retrieve King Neptune’s crown and save Bikini Bottom from being taken over by a mysterious intruder.

overview.de: Bei einem Autounfall verliert Dr. Amy Larsen ihr Gedächtnis. Als Assistenzärztin muss sie wieder von vorne beginnen und ihr Leben neu aufbauen.
overview.en: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away.
A sweeping western tale about the conflict between the Apache and the white man as a cowboy travels with a family being pursued by the Apache.
A Philly mechanic is shocked to learn that he is the heir to an English Duke.
A prince finds his way to Queens during Christmas when a local woman enlists his help with a children's Christmas show. Stars Megan Park, Julian Morris.

Undertaker Cedric Brown is again faced with an almost impossible task: He has to look for a nanny for his seven naughty children within a very short time, who have only had pranks and mischief on their minds since their mother's death. After the employment agency rejects him again, one night, the gruesome nanny Mcphee knocks on the door. The children want to get rid of this nanny too, but they begin to behave as if by magic. When their nasty great-aunt Adelaide wants the house back, the children have to work with Nanny McPhee to prevent the worst.

title.de: Find me in Paris - Tanz durch die Zeit

overview.en: When Lena Grisky, a Russian Princess and student at the Paris Opera Ballet School accidentally time travels to present day, she must quickly adapt if she hopes to keep her secret and hide from the dangerous Time Collectors.

overview.de: A new generation of activists fights to free American Indian Movement leader Leonard Peltier, who spent decades in prison for a disputed conviction.
overview.en: A new generation of activists fights to free American Indian Movement leader Leonard Peltier, who spent decades in prison for a disputed conviction.

title.de: Ganz oder gar nicht: Die Serie

overview.en: The gang is back after 25 years, swapping their stage costumes for dognapping, racing pigeons and a very unconventional hostage situation; but when tragedy strikes, the whole Monty gang must pull together for a common purpose: to honor an old friend.

title.de: Godzilla II: King of the Monsters

overview.de: Als die titanischen Monster sich erheben, muss sich das kryptozoologische Monarch Institut Godzilla, Mothra, Rodan und King Ghidorah bei deren Kampf um die Vorherrschaft stellen.
overview.en: When ancient god-sized monsters rise again, the crypto-zoological agency Monarch faces off against Godzilla, Mothra, Rodan, and King Ghidorah as they all vie for supremacy.

overview.de: Ein Junge bricht bei seinem neuen Haustier versehentlich drei wichtige Regeln und setzt dadurch eine Horde von übelwollenden, spitzbübischen Monstern in einer Kleinstadt frei.
overview.en: Some furry and not-so-cute little creatures besiege a small town after a young man ignores the warnings of a wise elder regarding their care and feeding.

overview.de: Von einem Meisterschaftsspiel im Fernsehen inspiriert, tritt der Highschool-Schüler Hinata trotz seiner geringen Körpergröße einem Volleyball-Klub bei.
overview.en: Inspired by a championship match he sees on TV, junior high schooler Hinata joins a volleyball club and begins training, despite his short height.

A sheltered teenage boy comes of age during a wild summer he spends in Cape Cod getting rich from selling pot to gangsters, falling in love for the first time, partying and eventually realizing that he is in over his head.

title.de: Joy for Christmas - Viel Gutes zu Weihnachten

overview.en: A publicist recruits a stubborn baseball star to help save her family's yearly toy drive — a strategy that sparks more than just Christmas cheer.
After losing out on a promotion, an assistant manager at a big box store reinvents her life to prove to Madison Avenue what street smarts can do.

overview.de: "Man kann niemals zu reich sein … oder zu lustig. Komiker Damon Wayans (Fernsehserie ""In Living Color"", The Last Boy Scout - Das Ziel ist Überleben) bringt seine übel gesinnte Galerie von unerhörten Charakteren in diese actionreiche Komödie über einen Trickbetrüger, der versucht sich zu bessern, aber immer wieder in die falsche Richtung gezogen wird."
overview.en: A con artist tries to go straight in a credit card company’s mailroom, but mounting debts tempt him back to schemes to impress an ambitious assistant.
A Catholic French couple sees their life upside down when their four daughters get married to men of different religion and origins.
Three monster loving kids living with their monster hunting grandpa. What could go wrong?

overview.de: Nachdem er seinen Mobber vor einem Schurken rettet, erhält ein ganz normaler Schüler eine Superkraft. Nun lässt er sich an einer Elite-Akademie zum Helden ausbilden.
overview.en: Despite being born powerless into a super-powered world, Izuku refuses to give up on his dream of becoming a hero. He enrolls himself in a prestigious hero academy with a deadly entrance exam. To make the grade, he’ll have to put in some serious study time with the mightiest hero of all.
This documentary chronicles the life story of the Dallas Mavericks' Dirk Nowitzki and his inspiring journey from Germany to superstardom in the NBA.

overview.de: Mit 160 Millionen kommt man heute nicht mehr so weit. Für Danny und seine Freunde wird es also Zeit, einen neuen umwerfenden Plan auszuführen - oder besser gleich mehrere Pläne...
overview.en: After splitting the $160 million take, each of the infamous Ocean's crew have tried to go straight, lay low and live a legit life ... but that's proven to be a challenge.

title.de: Particle Fever - Die Jagd nach dem Higgs

overview.en: Particle Fever follows the inside story of six brilliant scientists seeking to unravel the mysteries of the universe, documenting the successes and setbacks in the planet's most significant and inspiring scientific breakthrough.

overview.de: Was machen Haustiere, wenn sie allein sind? Terrier Max und seine Freunde geraten in ein wildes Abenteuer. Pfiffiger Animationsspaß vom "Ich - Einfach unverbesserlich"-Team.
overview.en: When their owners leave for the day, pets in a Manhattan apartment building gossip with friends, satisfy their sweet tooths, and throw outrageous parties. But when a pampered terrier and his unruly new "roommate" from the pound get lost in the urban jungle of New York City, they must put aside their differences to survive the epic journey back home.
Ash and Pikachu are off to the distant Unova region where they'll encounter new friends, new rivals, new challenges, and all-new Pokémon!
A young boy takes a journey with his Pokemon partner to become the Pokémon League champion.

title.de: RBG - Ein Leben für die Gerechtigkeit

overview.en: This documentary is an intimate portrait of Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg and her decades of achievement and legal legacy.

overview.de: Im Jahr 2045, der Virtual-Reality-Welt, ist die OASIS die Zukunft. Begleiten Sie Wade & seine Freunde auf der digitalen Schatzsuche durch ein Universum voller Geheimnisse und Gefahren.
overview.en: Steven Spielberg's futuristic tale in which the late creator of a virtual universe leaves it to anyone who can find an Easter Egg.

overview.de: Chief Inspector Lee Detective Carter sind wieder da dieses Mal mischen die unfreiwilligen Par tner Paris auf, um einer explosiven Verschwörung auf die Spur zu kommen.
overview.en: The misfit detective partners from East and West find themselves in Paris battling a wing of the Chinese organized crime family of the Triads.

overview.de: Mecha Elmo, Mecha Abby und Mecha Cookie Monster nutzen ihre Fähigkeiten, um Probleme in der Stadt zu lösen: Wie baut man eine Brücke? Warum schmilzt Schnee? Was muss ein Monster tun, um einen Keks zu bekommen? Die drei entdecken dabei die Eigenschaften ihrer Anzüge und lernen zusammenzuarbeiten.
overview.en: Mecha Elmo, Mecha Cookie Monster and Mecha Abby are ready to problem solve the most out-of-this-world situations. Using their robo-skills, the Mecha Builders are here to help -- it just might take them a few tries before they save the day!

Sherlock Yack is the world's first and only zoo detective, who tracks down bad guys of every size, shape, fur or feather. With his magnifying glass, his sharp logic and his assistant Hermione, he always finds the culprit. There are no murders or violence in these 11-minute episodes. And even though the fur flies and feathers get ruffled, things never get out of hand!

overview.de: Jetts erste Lieferung geht in den Himalaya. Er bringt Akas einen Drachen, den er beim Drachenfest steigen lassen mC6chte. ZunC¤chst muss der Drachen zusammengebaut und schlieClich ausprobiert werden. Als sich Akas und sein jC<ngerer Bruder Remi darC<ber streiten, wer von ihnen denn nun mit dem neuen Drachen spielen darf, nutzen zwei rote Pandas die Gelegenheit, um eine kleine Flugrunde zu drehen.
overview.en: Follow the adventures of an adorable jet and his amazing plane pals as they travel the world solving problems and delivering packages to kids.
Una exitosa mujer de negocios regresa a casa para leer el testamento de su tía y descubre que ha heredado la mitad de un famoso negocio de dulces.

title.de: Tatort Pyramide - Grabräubern auf der Spur

overview.en: Featuring exclusive access, Egypt's Lost Pyramid opens a 4,000-year-old crypt to reveal new mysteries about an unknown princess and an ancient crime.

overview.de: Adam Clay führt ein zurückgezogenes Leben als Bienenzüchter. Als seine beste Freundin Eloise Opfer von Betrügern wird, zeigt er sein wahres Gesicht und macht Jagd auf die Drahtzieher, die für den Vorfall verantwortlich sind.
overview.en: In The Beekeeper, one man's brutal campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after he is revealed to be a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization known as “Beekeepers.”

overview.de: Actionreiches Endzeitepos: Denzel Washington zieht als Einzelgänger durch ein verwüstetes Amerika und verteidigt ein machtvolles Buch gegen den Despoten Gary Oldman.
overview.en: Eli walks alone in post-apocalyptic America. He heads west on a mission he doesn’t fully understand but knows he must complete. In his backpack is the last copy of a book that could become the wellspring of a revived society. Eli keeps his blade sharp and his survival instincts sharper as his quest thrusts him into explosive conflict with a resourceful warlord set on possessing the book.

overview.de: Die Straßen haben ihn hart gemacht, aber das Land könnte ihn brechen. Als Tonnano den Großstadtdschungel gegen das gesetzlose Farmland eintauscht, sieht er sich mit unbekannten Gefahren und einem brutalen Kampf ums Überleben konfrontiert.
overview.en: Die Straßen haben ihn hart gemacht, aber das Land könnte ihn brechen. Als Tonnano den Großstadtdschungel gegen das gesetzlose Farmland eintauscht, sieht er sich mit unbekannten Gefahren und einem brutalen Kampf ums Überleben konfrontiert.
The privileged life of a pampered dog named Trouble is turned upside-down when he gets lost and must learn to survive on the big-city streets.

When Jenny attends a wedding at a magical ice hotel, she is surprised when she connects with the best man, Craig, and his daughter. Will the romance of the hotel bring them together? Stars Emilie Ullerup and Kevin McGarry.

A Hallmark Channel original movie. When Hanna, a travel agent up for a promotion is directed to forgo her tropical vacation to instead visit the world-famous Ice Hotel, she discovers her sacrifices are more than compensated when she meets Ben, the designer and co-owner. As they spend more and more time together, Hanna starts thinking of her old dream of running her own hotel...and if the future includes Ben.
For the first time, Yugi, Jaden and Yusei fight together against when a time traveler comes to destroy the Duel Monsters game!

Spencer and Lola couldn't be more different. He's a cat person, and she loves dogs. When a reservation mix-up lands them and their pets in the same vacation house, they have to find a way to get along without killing each other.

title.de: A Tale of Two Christmases - Ein Weihnachten kommt selten allein

overview.en: Emma explores two paths her holiday could take, one at home, one in the city.

In the superficial world of high fashion, image is everything. Styles come and go, and the only constants are the super thin beauties who wear them. How can an ordinary girl from Queens possibly fit in?
Raised by their human dad, a scrappy young musical chipmunk and his brothers get into mischief and learn plenty of valuable lessons along the way.

title.de: Barbie - Skipper und das große Babysitting Abenteuer
title.en: Barbie: Skipper and the Big Babysitting Adventure

overview.en: Hang out with Barbie's younger sister, Skipper! Skipper takes a summer job at a water park when her babysitting business hits a snag. A birthday party at the park goes awry and her babysitting skills save the day! With renewed confidence, she and her new friends start a babysitting squad. Meet new friends and jam out to 2 new songs!
Barbie stars as a shy princess who discovers a whole new fairytale world filled with fairies, mermaids and unicorns.

overview.de: Matthew Modine spielt die Hauptrolle als Highschool-Ringer, der versucht, viel zu schnell 23 Pfund zu verlieren, um es mit dem unbesiegten Meister der 168-Pfund-Klasse aufzunehmen.
overview.en: A gentle but driven 18-year-old underdog toils against the odds to become Washington state’s top wrestler while winning the heart of a young drifter.

title.de: Der Rebell - Von Leimen nach Wimbledon

overview.en: In 1982, Coach Günther Bosch mentors fiery tennis player Boris Becker to Wimbledon history, but tougher challenges lie ahead.
He's a Pro. She's a Natural., Almost Totally In Control, He Works Alone...She Doesn't Care, Being a spy is tough. Training a 9-year-old girl to be one is even tougher.
The sea is deep and full of secrets. The Nektons, an amazing family of explorers, want to learn them all.  But in their way are astonishing creatures, dangerous pirates and mysterious Guardians!

overview.de: Dune: Part Two erkundet die mythische Reise von Paul Atreides, der sich mit Chani und den Fremen vereint, während er sich auf einen Kreuzzug der Rache gegen die Verschwörer begibt, die seine Familie zerstört haben. Er steht vor der Wahl zwischen der Liebe seines Lebens und dem Schicksal des bekannten Universums und versucht, eine schreckliche Zukunft zu verhindern, die nur er vorhersehen kann.
overview.en: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking vengeance for the death of his family.

title.de: Gremlins 2 - Die Rückkehr der kleinen Monster

overview.de: Sechs Jahre nachdem die Gremlins alle in Schutt und Asche gelegt hatten sind sie wieder zurück.
overview.en: Remember the Mogwai rules? Don't expose them to light. Don't feed them after midnight. And, above all, don't get them wet! Lucky for lovers of outrageous comedy that someone forgot one crucial rule, unleashing cuddly Gizmo and his nasty big brothers on a high-tech skyscraper run by a millionaire media mogul.

overview.de: Lan Jun, ein ganz normales junges Mädchen, wohnt mit ihrer Familie in der Metropole Ban Tang. Doch an ihrem 13. Geburtstag erfährt sie, dass sie die neue auserwählte "Jade Armor" ist.
overview.en: The martial arts-loving Lan Jun, an unlikely teenage heroine, must learn the ancient secrets of her family and uncover the unexpected, all while navigating life as a teen.

overview.de: „Karate Kid: Legends“ vereint die Kult-Martial-Arts-Meister einer der beliebtesten Filmreihen aller Zeiten, um eine völlig neue Geschichte voller Action und Herz zu erzählen. Als das Kung-Fu-Wunderkind Li Fong (Ben Wang) mit seiner Mutter nach New York City zieht, um eine angesehene Schule zu besuchen, findet er Trost in der Freundschaft zu einer Mitschülerin und ihrem Vater. Doch sein neu gefundener Frieden währt nicht lange, als er die unerwünschte Aufmerksamkeit eines furchteinflößenden örtlichen Karatemeisters auf sich zieht. Getrieben vom Wunsch, sich selbst zu verteidigen, begibt sich Li auf eine Reise, um am ultimativen Karatewettbewerb teilzunehmen. Geleitet von der Weisheit seines Kung-Fu-Lehrers Mr. Han (Jackie Chan) und des legendären Karate KIDS Daniel LaRusso (Ralph Macchio) vereint Li ihre einzigartigen Stile, um sich auf einen epischen Kampfsport-Showdown vorzubereiten.
overview.en: After relocating to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong attracts unwanted attention and embarks on a journey to enter the ultimate karate competition. Guided by the wisdom of his kung fu teacher, Mr. Han, and the legendary Daniel LaRusso, Li merges their unique styles to prepare for an epic martial arts showdown.

overview.de: Als vier verwöhnte Zootiere aus New York plötzlich schiffbrüchig auf der exotischen Insel Madagaskar stranden, müssen sie entdecken: Die Welt da draußen ist wirklich ein Dschungel! Gemeinsam mit einem ideenreichen Pinguin-Quartett, dem schrillen König Julien und seinem lustigen Lemurenvolk erleben sie ein wildes Abenteuer!
overview.en: A pack of not-so-wild animals experience some serious culture shock when they move from the Big Apple to the Mighty Jungle in this computer-animated comedy. Featuring the voice talents of: Ben Stiller, Chris Rock, Jada Pinkett-Smith and David Schwimmer.

overview.de: Die Welt ist nur eine Simulation: Keanu Reeves und Laurence Fishburne kämpfen in Teil 1 der bombastischen Sci-Fi-Saga als Cyber-Rebellen gegen die Macht der Maschinen. Vier Oscars!
overview.en: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, and Carrie Ann Moss star in this groundbreaking sci-fi classic where Neo (Reeves), a skilled hacker learns reality is a simulation and becomes humanity's last hope in a war against intelligent machines.

overview.de: Die sechsteilige Serie erzählt die faszinierende Lebensgeschichte der niederländischen Königin Máxima.

After 18 years, we have the newest Dragon Ball story from creator Akira Toriyama.
With Majin Buu defeated, Goku has taken a completely new role as...a radish farmer?! With Earth at peace, our heroes have settled into normal lives. But they can’t get too comfortable. overview.en: Welcome to the world of Minecraft, where creativity doesn’t just help you craft, it’s essential to one’s survival! Four misfits find themselves pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld: a cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they’ll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected expert crafter, Steve. Together, their adventure will challenge all five to be bold and to reconnect with the qualities that make each of them uniquely creative ... the very skills they need to thrive back in the real world.
